Context

Hexa is looking for its new Office & Event Manager, for our offices at 12 rue Martel, Paris 10e. Our current office manager is moving on after some great years here.

The place is La Cristallerie: 800 m² under a glass roof, twelve meeting rooms, an atrium that seats 80, a professional kitchen and a three-camera podcast studio. Around 150 people work here every day, between our core team, the 12 companies we build each year, the 60 in our portfolio and our subtenants.

Why the role exists

No two weeks in this building look alike. 😄 A company arrives as a team of two and leaves as fifteen. A founder flies in from Berlin for 48 hours and needs a desk, a room and a coffee that does not taste like an airport. Event for 100 on Tuesday, podcast shoot Wednesday, masterclass Thursday morning with the atrium reset by 9am.

We are looking for the person who holds all of that together: the walls and the vendors, and the atmosphere too. Someone who knows the first name of everyone who walks through the door, who knows which team arrived on Monday and still needs introducing, who notices the startup keeping to itself in the corner and goes to get them.

The team

You would report to Camille, VP People & Community. And work in a team of six: Laure on Talent Acquisition, Juliette on HR Ops, Paul as Talent Engineer and Faustine as Head of Community. A small team, a wide scope, and people who genuinely enjoy working together.

Missions

Run the building:

  • Own the vendor relationships (cleaning, maintenance, security, caterers, suppliers): choose them, negotiate them, hold them to their word.

  • Own the venue budget end to end, trade-offs included.

  • Manage the space itself: floor plan, teams moving in and out, room bookings, and the diplomacy of four people wanting the atrium on the same Thursday.

  • Handle whatever the building throws at you, from the leak to the AC giving up on conference day, through to resolution.

  • Keep the podcast studio alive: bookings, setup, guest welcome, gear in working order.

Animate the workplace:

  • Be the face of the place, the person people come to for everything and the one who already anticipated half of it.

  • Onboard incoming teams: the tour, the house rules, introductions to their new neighbours, the small fixes of week one.

  • Engineer the encounters, like a lunch that seats two founders together because you noticed they were solving the same problem.

  • Read the temperature of the building and flag what is wrong before it reaches us on its own.

Produce the events:

  • Breakfasts, masterclasses, demo days, dinners, parties, offsites, farewells, birthdays. The build-up (budget, vendors, logistics, run of show) and the day itself (setup, coordination, being in the room, breakdown).

  • Host our startups' and subtenants' own events too, and make sure they leave wanting the date back next quarter.

Look after the core team:

  • The office management essentials for 40 people: orders, mail, welcome packs, equipment, the small daily emergencies.

  • Plus support to the HR team on people experience for Hexa employees: offsites, team retreats, demo times.

Who we are looking for

You have run a venue, with clients inside it and vendors around it. Probably from hospitality (operations manager, duty manager, head concierge, meetings & events manager), from events (venue manager, production coordinator, stage or technical manager), or from managed offices, coworking, campuses and incubators.

  • You can handle a budget and negotiate without turning it into a standoff.

  • The extra mile is a reflex. You go and buy the flowers yourself because the florist sent something sad, and you stay twenty minutes longer because the evening is going well.

  • You like people, and it shows without you having to work at it.

  • The unexpected energizes you rather than tightening you up. A leak never gives notice, and neither does a founder.

  • Working French and English. The building is bilingual.

One thing we would rather tell you upfront

This is a job you do on your feet, in the building, with the people in it. It is hands-on rather than strategic, it does not involve running cross-functional projects, and it will not evolve into HR process design. If your ambition is to move into Ops, People or a Chief of Staff track, we would rather be honest now and let you find a better fit elsewhere.

In exchange, you get a venue of your own: a place with a name, a glass roof and a reputation, and you are the person behind it.

  • Health insurance with 50% coverage for you and your family

  • 1% Holiday bonus

  • The Hexa ecosystem: 12 companies built a year, 60 in the portfolio, a permanent flow of founders, operators and investors. You will meet more people here in a month than in a year anywhere else.

  • Full autonomy on your scope, and the budget that goes with it.

jobs.title: Conseiller·ère commercial·e terrain B2C F/H
jobs.description:
Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech.
 
Comment on fait ?  On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. 

On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques.

Mais on ne va pas tout te dire de nous tout de suite : on va surtout parler de toi

On a besoin de ton énergie pour faire passer toute la Bretagne au vert — en porte-à-porte, en stand, et partout où une bonne idée peut ouvrir une porte.

Ton quotidien, c’est l’action !
  • Prospecter & convaincre : À la rencontre de nouveaux clients, en porte-à-porte ou en stand. Chaque porte est une opportunité.

  • Accompagner & conseiller : Aide les foyers à réduire leur facture et leur impact grâce à des économies d'énergie et des écogestes simples.

  • La meilleure école de vente : Écouter, pitcher, s'adapter, signer. Chaque contrat activé = une commission directe.

  • S'amuser, avant tout : Sur le terrain, en stand, en équipe. On célèbre chaque victoire, petite ou grande !


    • Ce poste est fait pour toi si :
  • Tu as le contact humain et les échanges sincères sont dans ta nature.

  • Tu as un esprit de conquête et tu adores te dépasser.

  • Tu es résilient·e : un « non » ne t'arrête pas, c'est un échauffement qui te motive.

  • Tu es autonome et responsable : tu pilotes ta journée comme un indépendant, mais avec une équipe solide derrière toi.

  • Tu partages tes victoires et tu cherches un job qui a du sens.

    • Pas d'expérience dans l'énergie ? Aucun souci : on te forme. L'envie, elle, ne s'apprend pas.


    Ce qu'on te promet :
  • La reconnaissance : Ton travail est vu, valorisé et célébré. Ici, les efforts ne passent jamais inaperçus.

  • Ton épanouissement : Le terrain est exigeant, on le sait. Alors on prend soin de toi : cadre bienveillant, écoute, et une équipe qui t'aide à durer.

  • La liberté de proposer : Une idée pour vendre autrement ? Propose-la : ici, les bonnes idées deviennent des projets.

    • Une vraie formation : Formation complète dès ton arrivée sur le métier, l'offre et le terrain. On ne te lâche jamais seul·e.

    Une rémunération et des avantages qui donnent envie :

  • Un fixe attractif selon ton expérience et ton profil.

  • Un variable non plafonné : mieux tu vends, plus tu gagnes.

  • Des primes de performance & qualité + des challenges toute l'année.

  • Une prime de formation à la validation de la période d'essai.

  • Et de vrais plus : intéressement au capital, excellente mutuelle (Alan), forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge des transports au-delà du légal, congés pour projet associatif et équipement fourni.


    • Et la cerise sur le gâteau : Octopus Energy

    Nous, on veut faire passer tout le monde au vert, dans une entreprise qui met le client au cœur de tout. Résultat : le meilleur score des fournisseurs d'énergie français sur Google Reviews et Trustpilot, 5ᵉ fournisseur français en 10 ans. Côté équipe, nous sommes classés n°1 au Great Place to Work 2026 (catégorie +200 salariés) et figurons au palmarès Best Workplaces for Women.

    Et si dans ta tête tu entends « Allez, pourquoi pas ? » — Postule !

  • Entretiens et prise de poste rapides 

  • Avant de signer : une journée d'immersion sur le terrain avec l'équipe. Tu vois le vrai métier, et on se choisit mutuellement.

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - AI Native
jobs.description:
Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution? 

Vision: 

As a leading software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust is a global company dedicated to offering an integrated suite of legal and governance products. Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world's leading Legal Tech company, aiming for a valuation exceeding $1 billion by 2026. 

Our Impact: 

From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams in our 8 offices across France, the US, Mexico, MEA, Germany, Spain, Italy, and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America, and the Middle East. 

Our Recognition: 

DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the "Happy at Work" and "Tech at Work" labels every year since 2019. 

The Role:

Lini is DiliTrust's proprietary AI engine, powering Ask Lini, Risk Detector, Document Summarization, Minute Generation, and every AI capability across the suite.

We are building a dedicated squad around it and are looking for a strong Software / Product Engineer, with a focus our platform architecture, to help us bring it to the next level. 

As a Software Engineer work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering. You will contribute to building, improving, and scaling the features that make Lini a reliable and powerful AI layer across the entire DiliTrust suite. 

We are looking for an engineer who writes clean, production-ready code and is comfortable taking ownership of features end-to-end, from technical design to deployment. We also care about how you think about AI: whether you bring genuine curiosity to the product, and whether you can translate a model capability into a great user experience. 

Missions

  • Write specifications as the durable asset of the project. Executable acceptance criteria, and — crucially — the non-functional requirements that specs almost never carry: data classification, endpoint × role authorization matrix, volumetry assumptions, latency and throughput budgets. These are the requirements whose later correction is superlinear, so they get decided before generation, not after.
  • Freeze the contracts before any fan-out. API schemas, types, module boundaries, invariants. Agents do not negotiate an interface in the hallway: each will make a plausible and incompatible assumption, discovered at integration.
  • Pilot coding agents with a tight brief and a bounded context — narrow tasks, defined input and output artifacts, explicit stop conditions and budgets, full traceability of what produced each change.
  • Keep producer and verifier separate. You do not sign off alone on generation you piloted, and you act as independent verifier on your peers' slices — with an adversarial brief ("find what breaks against this spec"), never "confirm this looks fine".
  • Build the asymmetric gates that make the slice safe at volume — expensive to satisfy, cheap to check: property tests, contract tests, query-count and allocation budgets, execution-plan checks, policy-as-code, backward-compatibility proofs. Written before the implementation exists, so the agent closes the feedback loop itself without consuming human attention.
  • Use code reading as a calibration instrument, not as a gate. Sample deliberately, by risk zone, to measure the real defect rate of the generator-plus-gates pair and to keep the team's mental model of its own system alive.
  • Keep work-in-progress low. Capped PR size, thin vertical slices, trunk-based with very short branches, feature flags over long-lived branches, CI as the agent's first task rather than its last. More features in flight does not mean faster delivery when the bottleneck is verification.
  • Design for blast radius. Reversibility, progressive delivery, structured logs, traces, metrics and instrumentation generated as a matter of course. On many paths, detecting in five minutes beats three days of review that prevents nothing.

Requirements

Being based in France with full working rights. Fluent in French and English.

Experience & Seniority:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion spent building and operating B2B SaaS platforms in production
  • Proven ownership of features across their full lifecycle — design, delivery, iteration, maintenance — on long-lived, multi-year products
  • Strong background in complex, scalable web architectures, including real modularity: you have seen where coupling stops parallel work dead

AI-Native Practice:

  • Demonstrated, sustained use of coding agents in production work — not autocomplete, but delegated implementation with review and accountability
  • A concrete, articulated view of where generated code fails: correlated defects rather than idiosyncratic ones, uniform surface quality that destroys the usual "look here" review signals, plausibility with no author to interrogate
  • Comfort being accountable for code you did not author, and the discipline to refuse a change you cannot explain

Verification & Quality:

  • Real fluency in property-based testing, contract testing, and deriving tests from the specification rather than from the code
  • Test-data strategy, including maintaining a volumetrically representative dataset as part of the verification apparatus — not a nice-to-have
  • Instinct for the difference between a rigorous check and a scalable one: does the cost of checking grow with the volume produced?

Security & Performance (non-negotiable on this role):

  • Authorization modelling in multi-tenant systems, and why declarative, centrally enforced authorization beats reviewing each endpoint. Generated code reliably checks who you are and regularly forgets whether you are allowed
  • Awareness of the attack surface specific to an agent-assisted pipeline: prompt injection through ticket descriptions, code comments and dependency READMEs; supply-chain risk on hallucinated package names; least privilege for non-human identities; and the most frequent risk of all — production data or proprietary code leaking into the development loop
  • Performance as a measured number rather than a code-reading opinion: query budgets per HTTP request, N+1, unbounded result sets, missing indexes on new query paths, network calls in loops, execution-plan review. These are invisible at test-data scale and expensive in production

Product & Team Collaboration:

  • Excellent written communication — specification writing is now a core engineering skill on this role, not documentation overhead
  • Extensive experience working directly with product managers, designers and stakeholders in a product-oriented setup
  • Strong sense of ownership and sound judgment on risk: what to build, what not to build, what residual risk is acceptable and why

Education:

  • Master's degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience in senior SaaS environments

What this role is not

We would rather say it up front:

  • It is not a prompt-engineering role, and it is not an ML/LLM research role.
  • It is not a role where green tests are sufficient evidence. On security and performance, "the spec is met and the tests pass" is not a weak signal — it is a null one.
  • It is not a ticket queue. The profile that shrinks in an AI-native team is the one whose value was implementing assigned tickets between two boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

  • Backend: Node.js / TypeScript
  • Frontend: Vue.js 3
  • Database: PostgreSQL, MariaDB
  • DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
  • Cloud: GCP

Engineering apparatus you will use and help build: coding agents orchestrated deterministically in CI, aspect-scoped verification agents (authorization, performance, spec conformance, dependencies), policy-as-code, property-based and contract testing, volumetric test datasets, load and endurance gates on critical paths, feature flags, progressive delivery and end-to-end tracing.

What we offer

  • Join a fast-growing company in a friendly, international environment — engineering primarily in Paris, with further engineering presence in Berlin, Montreal and Wilmington (DE), and offices across France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Canada, the USA, Mexico and Dubai;
  • Our "Remote Policy" guarantees that you can find the right balance between "Onsite" and "Remote";
  • Last but not least, all the day-to-day benefits of the CSE, luncheon vouchers, profit sharing bonuses, etc...

Recruitment process

  • Interview with a TA team member (30/45 mins)
  • Interview with the Engineering Manager (1h)
  • Technical interview (1h30) — two parts: turning an ambiguous requirement into a specification with executable acceptance criteria, then an adversarial review of an agent-generated diff against that specification
  • Interview with the CTO (45 mins)

jobs.title: Legal Engineer - AI Quality (Internship)
jobs.description:
Legal Engineer Intern — AI Quality & Evaluation 

Internship · Team: Machine Learning · [Paris — hybrid] · 6 months · Start: ASAP · Working languages: English & French 

 

About the role 

We are embedding AI across every DiliTrust module, and the hardest question is not "does it run?" but "is it good enough for a legal professional to rely on?" Answering that requires someone who understands both the model and the law. 

That is this role. You will join the ML team as the legal voice inside the build loop, translating legal expertise into the test sets, evaluation criteria and documentation that determine whether our AI features ship. You will work day to day with ML engineers and Product Managers, and your findings will directly shape what gets released and what goes back for rework. 

This is a legal engineering position, not a legal practice one. You will not draft contracts; you will define what a correct answer looks like on a contract, at scale, and hold the system to it. 

What you'll do 

Design and run AI evaluations (Lini) 

Build evaluation campaigns for Lini across all modules (CLM, Board Portal, Legal Entity Management, Matter Management). Define what "correct" means for each feature: scoring rubrics, acceptance thresholds, and the edge cases that matter to a lawyer but are invisible to a metric. Run the campaigns, analyse the results, and escalate quality issues to the ML team with a clear diagnosis rather than a bug report. 

Own the Golden Data 

Build, curate and maintain the reference test sets the team measures against. Source representative legal documents, establish the ground truth, and keep coverage honest as features evolve. This dataset becomes the team's working definition of quality, and it will be yours. 

Turn client feedback into product signal 

Collect and structure the feedback on AI features gathered by Customer Success. Build a failure taxonomy instead of a list of complaints, so that recurring weaknesses become prioritisable work items. Keep the feedback documentation current on Confluence. 

Map the competitive landscape 

Track legal tech products shipping notable AI capabilities and maintain a clear-eyed view of the market: what they claim, what they actually do, where we lead and where we don't. 

Document and enable 

Write and maintain the Confluence reference on our AI features — capabilities, limitations, appropriate use cases — for Product, Sales, Customer Success and Support. If a colleague can explain the limits of a feature to a client without asking the ML team, you have done this well. 

Who we're looking for 

A gap year student (Bac +4/+5) matching one of two profiles: 

  • Legal background with a real pull toward technology. You have a law degree, and you find yourself more curious about how the tool works than about the case law. 

  • Technical or engineering background with genuine interest in law. You can read a model output critically, and you want to work in a domain where precision has consequences. 

In both cases, the person we are looking for is: 

  • Curious, autonomous and rigorous — able to own a workstream without being managed through it 

  • Analytically minded: structures information, spots inconsistencies, synthesises clearly 

  • An excellent communicator in French and English, written and spoken 

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where the roadmap moves 

Required skills 

  • Solid legal knowledge, or a demonstrated ability to get up to speed on legal concepts fast 

  • Fluent French and English — English is the working language inside the ML team 

  • Proficiency with productivity tools: Confluence, Jira (or equivalent), Slack, Excel / Google Sheets 

  • Nice to have: familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI evaluation concepts. Hands-on experience with AI tools applied to legal work is a strong plus. 

What you'll get out of it 

Direct exposure to how AI features are built, measured and shipped in a production legal tech product — inside the ML team rather than adjacent to it. Legal engineering is becoming its own career track, and this is a year of it on a real product. 

Recruitment process 

Two steps, and we move quickly. 

1. Introductory call (20–30 min, phone or video) 

A conversation with [hiring manager / talent team] on your background, what draws you to this intersection of law and AI, and the practical basics (dates, duration, school requirements). Partly in English. 

2. Use case (take-home + debrief) 

We send you a short, concrete exercise: a set of AI outputs on legal documents to assess. You tell us what is wrong, how you would measure it systematically, and what you would report back to the ML team. Expect around [2 hours] of work. We then discuss it together for 45–60 minutes with the ML team and Product. We are not looking for the right answer — we are looking at how you reason, structure a problem, and defend a judgement call.

En tant que de Data Scientist / Data Analyst, vous serez notamment en charge des missions suivantes :

Data Science / Machine Learning : 

  • Data Preprocessing : Vous découvrez et vous appropriez de nouvelles sources de données ;
  • Feature Engineering : Vous créez de nouvelles features à intégrer aux modèles, et analysez la pertinence de ces features ;

jobs.title: Design System Manager - Consultant.e
jobs.description:
Mindset
Chez Thiga, nous considérons qu’un Design System n’est pas seulement un ensemble de composants ou de règles : c’est un produit à part entière. Un produit pensé pour évoluer, répondre aux besoins des équipes, et accompagner la croissance de l’entreprise.
Créer et faire vivre un Design System demande une vision, une stratégie claire, et une gouvernance solide. Il faut piloter son adoption, anticiper ses usages à grande échelle, et s’assurer qu’il réponde aux enjeux à la fois du Design et de la Tech. C’est un levier puissant pour faire monter en maturité les organisations, structurer la collaboration entre les équipes, et diffuser une culture produit forte.

Aujourd'hui, un Design System bien structuré est aussi la condition sine qua non pour tirer
pleinement parti de l'IA dans les workflows design et prototypage. Tokens cohérents,
composants documentés, nomenclature rigoureuse autant de fondations qui permettent
d'exploiter les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Lovable, v0...) de manière fiable et scalable.
Le.la Design System Manager de demain est celui.celle qui anticipe ces usages et structure son système en conséquence.

Les Design System Managers que nous recherchons pensent leur système comme un produit
vivant, automatisé au maximum, et conçu pour connecter Design et Ingénierie dans un workflow
sans friction.

How we work together 🤝
  • Mettre en place des rituels d'adoption et d'amélioration continue :offices hours, sessions de feedback, contribution guidelines pour que le DS soit co-construit et adopté par toutes les équipes.
  • Aligner Design et Engineering en continu : organiser des syncs réguliers avec les équipes dev pour garantir la cohérence entre les composants Figma et leur implémentation code. Le DS ne vit pas dans Figma seul; il vit dans la production.
  • Piloter l'alignement stratégique multi-équipes : s'assurer que Produit, Tech, Design et business partagent la même vision et roadmap du DS, intégrée au même niveau que les autres produits.
  • Répondre aux besoins des utilisateurs et contributeurs : centraliser les demandes, prioriser les évolutions, et faciliter la contribution fluide de designers, développeurs et PMs.
  • Fédérer autour d'une culture DS partagée : faire du DS un produit vivant et co-créé, en favorisant des échanges transparents et en embarquant les équipes dans sa vision long terme

    • How we get work done 🚀
  • Définir et piloter la roadmap du DS : feuille de route alignée sur les priorités produit et business, avec des objectifs mesurables à court et long terme.
  • Automatiser les workflows du DS au maximum : pipelines de tokens, synchronisation design to code en temps réel, scripts de génération de documentation, réduire au minimum les tâches manuelles et les risques de désynchronisation.
  • Structurer le DS pour l'IA et le prototypage rapide : concevoir une architecture de composants et de tokens qui rende le DS exploitable par les outils d'IA générative (Figma Make, Cursor, v0, Lovable...). Cela implique : nomenclature stricte,variantes bien définies, props documentées, et une logique de composants qui s'aligne avec les patterns du code.
  • Garantir la cohérence design-code : mettre en place des outils de vérification automatique pour s'assurer que ce qui est designé est bien ce qui est développé sans avoir à le vérifier manuellement.
  • Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques à grande échelle : formations, ateliers, documentation vivante pour que le DS soit utilisé de manière fluide et scalable par toutes les équipes.
  • Mesurer l'impact et itérer : KPIs d'adoption, indicateurs de qualité, retours qualitatifs pour évaluer l'impact du DS et ajuster les priorités

    • How our work creates impact 🎯
  •  Accélérer le delivery produit : composants prêts à l'emploi, pipelines automatisés et prompts IA calibrés sur le DS. Les équipes conçoivent et développent plus vite, avec moins de friction
  • Rendre le prototypage IA fiable et scalable : un DS bien structuré devient le langage commun entre les designers et les outils d'IA les prototypes générés sont cohérents avec la prod, pas jetables
  • Garantir la qualité et la cohérence design à l'échelle : expérience utilisateur homogène, identité de marque renforcée, dette design et technique réduite
  • Réduire la dette et simplifier la maintenance : moins de doublons, moins de variantes inutiles, un code plus accessible et plus performant
  • Faire monter l'organisation en maturité design : culture de collaboration Design × Tech structurée, vision stratégique du design renforcée, documentation vivante comme levier de montée en compétence

    • Compétences 💼
  • Vision système et stratégie DS : u sais définir une stratégie de DS et la décliner en roadmap concrète, en alignement avec les priorités produit, tech et business. Tu fais preuve de leadership pour porter cette vision et embarquer les équipes.
  • Alignement Design-Engineering : tu as une solide compréhension des enjeux front-end (tokens, design-to-code, systèmes de composants) et tu dialogues en égal avec les développeurs pas seulement pour les convaincre, mais pour co-construire les bonnes solutions.
  • Automatisation et tooling DS : tu maîtrises les pipelines de tokens, les outils de documentation (Storybook, Zeroheight) et tu as une appétence pour l'automatisation des workflows DS.
  • IA et prototypage avancé : tu comprends comment un DS structuré permet de tirer parti des outils d'IA générative pour le design et le prototypage. Tu anticipes ces usages dans les décisions d'architecture du DS.
  • Gestion de produit interne : tu pilotes le DS comme un vrai produit : besoins utilisateurs, priorisation, KPIs, itération continue.
  • Communication et influence : tu sais formuler des livrables synthétiques et stratégiques (vision, roadmap, modèles de gouvernance, dashboards) pour aligner des interlocuteurs variés équipes opérationnelles, direction produit, stakeholders.
  • Outils : figma (Variables, Dev Mode, Make), Storybook, Zeroheight, Notion, Jira/Linear, Style Dictionary, et une bonne aisance avec les environnements no-code/low-code et outils IA de prototypage.
  • Anglais courant : à l'écrit comme à l'oral

    • Qualités 🌟
  •  Tu penses en systèmes : tu comprends les logiques systémiques et sais structurer un DS cohérent, extensible, et exploitable par l'IA
  • Tu automatises par réflexe : tu cherches à réduire les tâches manuelles et à construire des workflows robustes qui s'auto-maintiennent.
  • Tu es le pont entre Design et Tech : tu parles les deux langages et tu sais créer les conditions d'un alignement durable entre les équipes.
  • Tu portes une vision : tu es capable de convaincre, d'aligner et d'embarquer des designers comme des ingénieurs, des opérationnels comme des dirigeants.
  • Tu pilotes ton DS comme un produit : besoins utilisateurs internes, KPIs, roadmap priorisée tu traites le DS avec la même rigueur qu'un produit client.
  • Tu restes curieux·se et en veille : sur les outils, les pratiques et l'évolution rapide des Design Systems et des usages IA dans le design

    • Expérience 📇
  • Tu as au moins 5 ans d'expérience en Product Design, Design System Management ou un
    rôle similaire, avec une trajectoire confirmée ou senior
  • Tu as déjà créé ou fortement structuré un Design System de zéro ou à grande échelle, pas
    seulement contribué à l'un
  • Tu as mis en place des pipelines de tokens, des processus d'automatisation et des
    intégrations design to code
  • Tu as expérimenté avec des outils d'IA générative, dans un contexte design ou DS (Figma
    Make, Cursor, v0, Lovable, ou équivalent)
  • Tu as travaillé aussi bien en scale-up qu'en grand groupe, ce qui te donne une bonne
    lecture des modèles d'organisation et des leviers pour faire évoluer la maturité design.
  • Tu as travaillé en méthodologie agile et sais comment intégrer le DS dans ces processus de
    delivery.

    • Ce que nous offrons 🎊
  • Un on-boarding pour rencontrer tes collègues 
  • De l’apprentissage avec minimum 5 jours de formations à l’année, des sessions de partage hebdomadaires et du contenu pour te faire monter en compétences
  • Du mentoring sur ta mission par un pair plus confirmé 
  • Du confort avec deux jours de télétravail par semaine (selon ton client) complétés par un accès à un catalogue de matériels, ainsi qu’un Macbook Air ou un PC selon ta préférence.
  • Du fun avec des Thigapéros, des Team building et un séminaire (en prêtant attention à notre empreinte carbone).
  • Et pleins d’autres avantages comme une carte Swile, le remboursement de ton abonnement de transport à 50%/forfait mobilité durable, etc.

    • Les étapes du process 🎢
  • Un pré-entretien téléphonique avec une membre de l’équipe Recrutement
  • L'évaluation de ton portfolio par nos Designers
  • Une rencontre avec un.e Principal, un.e Manager de la Tribe ou un Partner pour s’assurer que nous partageons les mêmes valeurs et ambitions
  • Un entretien plus opérationnel avec un ou deux membres senior de notre équipe pour évaluer ta compréhension du rôle de Design System Manager, ta capacité à résoudre des problèmes liés au Design System, tes convictions, tes attentes, etc.
  • Une dernière rencontre pour finaliser le process, s’accorder sur une ambition commune, des objectifs et un périmètre d’intervention 🤝
    • Thiga accueille toutes les personnes compétentes et passionnées et s'engage en faveur de la diversité culturelle, l'égalité de genre et l'emploi des travailleurs handicapés — au contraire nous considérons la diversité comme une grande richesse !

Som utleierepresentant er du ansvarlig for å levere våre tjenester på en best mulig måte til våre kunder. Hverdagen består av utstrakt kundekontakt både ansikt til ansikt og pr. telefon og mail. Vi leverer en service hvor kundens behov alltid er i fokus. Logistikk, oversikt og kvalitet på bilflåte, salg, bestillinger og kundeservice.

  • Rapportering og annet forefallende kontorarbeid

Kvalifikasjoner

Som utleierepresentant er du den våre kunder møter hver dag. Du representerer Sixt Bilutleie og er genuint opptatt av service og trives med kundekontakt. Vi stiller høye krav til våre produkter og hvordan vi presenterer disse, med ett ønske om å overgå kundens forventinger. Du har også ansvar for standarden på produktet vi leverer. Hverdagen styres av kundens behov, og din evne til å arbeide hurtig og nøyaktig er avgjørende for den kvalitet vi leverer. Ved å levere en premium opplevelse, er du med å bygger Norges beste bilutleiekjede.  

  • Minimum førerkort klasse B (manuelt og automatgir)

  • Plettfri vandel (Politiattest)

  • Genuin serviceinnstilling og gode mellommenneskelige ferdigheter

  • Gode salgs ferdigheter

  • Hurtig og nøyaktig med stor arbeidskapasitet

  • Strukturert og evne til å styre logistikk i en stadig skiftende/hektisk hverdag

  • Flytende norsk / engelsk muntlig og skriftlig

  • Datakunnskaper (Microsoft Office). 

Vi tilbyr

Som ansatt i Sixt Bilutleie vil du være del av en organisasjon med flinke kolleger som alle ønsker å yte det beste for våre kunder. Som del av et team vil din innsats utgjøre en forskjell, og verdsettes deretter. Vi har gode trenings- og utvekslingsprogram som alle våre ansatte følger. For den rette vil det også være utviklingsmuligheter innen organisasjonen. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

Förskollärare sökes till Sjökulla förskola, Laholms kommun
jobs.description:
Om Laholms kommun

Det är i mötet med våra invånare som värdet av vårt arbete uppstår! Som medarbetare i Laholms kommun är du med och levererar tjänster och service till våra invånare – varje dag, året om. Laholms kommun rymmer allt från omsorg, stöd och utbildning för våra invånare till infrastruktur, underhåll, kulturliv och tillväxt. Vi tror på att varje medarbetare har drivkraften och förmågan att förbättra verksamheten och en vilja att utvecklas i sitt yrke.

Som medarbetare i Laholms kommun har du kollegor med många olika yrken och bakgrund, men det som förenar oss är vårt uppdrag och vår gemensamma värdegrund med ledorden glädje, mod, delaktighet, engagemang och gott föredöme

Om tjänsten

Som förskollärare ansvarar du för att strukturera, dokumentera och utveckla det pedagogiska arbetet utifrån förskolans läroplan tillsammans med ditt arbetslag.

Vi söker dig som är ansvarstagande, engagerad och en närvarande pedagog som vill vara delaktig i att skapa en utvecklande, rolig och lärorik förskola.

Vi står inför ett spännande år då vi precis starta upp verksamheten på vår nybyggda förskola.

Tjänsten är på en avdelning för äldre barn där vi jobbar i stor arbetslag.

Är du den vi söker?

För att vara aktuell för tjänsten behöver du ha förskollärarlegitimation utfärdat av skolverket.

Ett centralt arbete på förskolan är att vi arbetar språkmedvetet. Detta innebär att pedagogerna medvetet och systematiskt stödjer barns språkutveckling i alla delar av verksamheten. Genom samtal, högläsning, sång, rim och ramsor samt användning av visuella stödstrukturer som bildstöd och tecken som stöd, skapas rika språkliga miljöer där alla barns språkliga förmågor uppmärksammas och utvecklas. Särskild vikt läggs vid att inkludera flerspråkiga barns erfarenheter och resurser i det pedagogiska arbetet. Vi kommer under året att arbeta med Före Bornholmsmodellen" .

Du är väl förtrogen med förskolans uppdrag enligt läroplanen och ha god förmåga att omsätta våra styrdokument både i praktik och teori. Du har en drivkraft att ta ett pedagogiskt ansvar och tillsammans med arbetslaget utveckla verksamheten på förskolan utifrån varje barns unika förutsättningar. Du är positiv och har ett stort engagemang i ditt yrke samt en vilja att samarbeta och utvecklas tillsammans med barnen och arbetslaget på förskolan. Du ser möjligheter i mångfald och variation.

Du har förmåga att kommunicera, samordna och leda.

Utgångspunkten i ditt yrkesutövande är med hjälp av ett

lösnings inriktat fokus. Du ska ha god förmåga att se alla barn och ta hänsyn till deras individuella förutsättningar samt vill dela med dig av dina kunskaper och erfarenheter liksom du tar del av andras.

Om anställningen

Antal tjänster: 1

Tillträde den 5/10 2026.

Vik för tiden 5/10-23/12. Kan ev bli förlängt.

Intervjuer sker löpande.

Vid frågor efter den 25/9 kontakta rektor Helena Nilsson 0430-26644  

Övriga upplysningar

Är du intresserad utav uppdraget som RIB brandman i Laholms kommun kan du gå in på: Räddningstjänst - Laholms kommun

Här kan du få mer information om bland annat lönestatistik Kommunen som arbetsgivare.

Till följd av lag om belastningsregister ska utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister uppvisas vid anställning inom LSS, barnomsorg samt skola.

Arbete i hemmet med äldre och personer med funktionsnedsättning | Polismyndigheten

Arbete inom skola eller förskola | Polismyndigheten

Du som söker jobb och har skyddade personuppgifter ska kontakta rekryterande chef i annonsen som kommer guida dig vidare för en säker ansökningsprocess. Du ska inte ansöka digitalt via ansökningslänken

Information till annonssäljare

Vi undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

Vi erbjuder ett utvecklande arbete och friskvård i olika former samt tillämpar rökfri arbetstid.

Laholms kommun verkar för att alla medarbetare ska ha lika rättigheter och möjligheter och vi välkomnar alla sökande oavsett kön, könsöverskridande identitet eller uttryck, etnisk tillhörighet, funktionsnedsättning, sexuell läggning, religion eller annan trosuppfattning.

Fiberelektriker / fibertekniker sökes till Norge

Felfritt AB söker nu flera erfarna fiberelektriker och fibertekniker för kommande och pågående projekt i Norge.

Vi söker dig som har praktisk erfarenhet av fiberinstallationer och som är van vid att arbeta självständigt såväl som tillsammans med andra i större installations- och infrastrukturprojekt.

    OTDR-mätning och dokumentation
    

    Läsning av ritningar och installationsunderlag
    

    Dokumentation och egenkontroller

Krav

    Dokumenterad erfarenhet av fiberinstallationer
    

    Erfarenhet av fibersvetsning
    

    Kunskap inom mätning och felsökning av fiber
    

    Förmåga att läsa och arbeta efter ritningar och installationsunderlag
    

    Noggrant och säkerhetsmedvetet arbetssätt
    

    Förmåga att arbeta både självständigt och i team
    

    Svenska, norska eller engelska i tal

Meriterande

    Tidigare erfarenhet av arbete i Norge
    

    DSB-godkännande för arbete som elektriker i Norge
    

    Erfarenhet från större fiber-, telekom- eller infrastrukturprojekt
    

    Erfarenhet av stamfiber och större fiberinstallationer
    

    OTDR och dokumentation av fibernät
    

    Liftutbildning
    

    Fallskyddsutbildning
    

    ESA och andra relevanta utbildningar eller certifikat
    

    B-körkort

Anställning och arbetsplats

Arbetsplats: Norge

Omfattning: Heltid

Anställningsform: Projektanställning/visstidsanställning med möjlighet till fortsatt arbete

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Felfritt AB är ett svenskt installationsföretag som arbetar med elinstallationer, svagström, fiber, säkerhet samt mark och anläggning. Vi arbetar idag i större installations- och infrastrukturprojekt i Sverige och expanderar vår verksamhet i Norge.

Vi söker flera personer och genomför intervjuer löpande.

Skicka in din ansökan redan idag med CV, personligt brev, gärna referenser samt relevanta utbildningsintyg och certifikat till Robin@felfritt.net.

jobs.description:
Junior Key Account Sales Executive – Paris (Office-first)

Small businesses across France keep the local economy moving, and they need a payments partner that makes running a business simpler, not harder. That's where you come in.

Team description

Our Paris sales team helps small and growing merchants across France get set up with SumUp's payment tools, often as their very first introduction to the brand. We're a close-knit, target-driven group that thrives on outbound conversations, quick thinking and celebrating wins together. This role gives you a real seat at the table from day one: you'll own conversations end to end, learn the fundamentals of a fast-paced sales cycle and see the direct impact of your work every time a merchant signs up.

What you'll do

  • 💼 Reach out to small business prospects by phone, email and social media, starting the conversation and building the pipeline

  • 🤝 Get to know each business's needs and show how SumUp can genuinely help them

  • 🎤 Run product pitches and demos that turn curiosity into commitment

  • 🔥 Manage the full sales cycle, from first contact through to closing the deal

  • 📊 Track performance against targets and use feedback and data to keep improving

  • 🧠 Share ideas with the team and help build an energised, collaborative office culture

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Experience in outbound sales or business development, with a genuine drive to learn and grow quickly.

  • Comfort working with high volumes of phone-based outreach.

  • Curiosity and confidence when speaking with new people and solving their problems.

  • A results-driven mindset with a track record of working towards targets.

  • Fluency in French and English, given daily contact with local merchants and a global team.

Why you should join SumUp

  • 🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our Paris location. This involves an office-first setup

  • 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced

  • 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education

  • 💼 Financial security: corporate pension contributions that support your long-term future

  • 🏥 Healthcare support: we cover 50% of the monthly cost of your health insurance for your Mutuelle and Prévoyance

  • 🚌 Extra allowances: we offer restaurant tickets (Swile) and cover transportation costs

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.

jobs.description:
Commercial(e) terrain indépendant(e) – SumUp

Vous avez une réelle expérience de la prospection à froid, sur le terrain ou par téléphone ? Rejoignez SumUp et accompagnez les commerçants avec des solutions de paiement simples et reconnues.

Vos missions

  • Prospecter les cafés, restaurants, boutiques, salons et entreprises de votre secteur ;
  • Identifier leurs besoins, présenter la solution adaptée et réaliser des démonstrations ;
  • Accompagner les commerçants jusqu'à l'activation et développer votre portefeuille.

La prospection est réalisée par vos soins : aucun portefeuille de leads n'est fourni.

Votre rémunération

Cette activité est rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire fixe ni plafond :

  • 50 % de commission immédiate sur le matériel, les logiciels et les paiements générés par le commerçant au cours de son premier mois ;
  • 20 % de revenus récurrents sur l'activité de chaque commerçant signé, versés mensuellement pendant une durée pouvant aller jusqu'à 24 mois.

Exemple : un commerçant actif générant environ 15 000 € de volume de paiement mensuel peut vous permettre de percevoir plus de 1 000 € de commissions cumulées sur 24 mois.Ce montant indicatif varie selon les produits vendus, l'activation, le volume réel et le maintien de l'activité du commerçant. Aucun revenu minimum n'est garanti.

Vos outils et votre organisation

SumUp fournit une formation initiale, un terminal de démonstration et des supports commerciaux. Un référent de secteur reste disponible pour vous accompagner.

Votre zone est définie pendant le recrutement selon votre localisation et les secteurs ouverts. Vous organisez librement votre activité. Vos déplacements et les frais associés restent à votre charge ; aucun véhicule de fonction n'est fourni.

Votre profil

  • Au moins un an d'expérience en prospection à froid, terrain ou téléphonique, au cours des six dernières années ;
  • À l'aise dans une démarche commerciale proactive auprès de professionnels ;
  • Autonome, persévérant(e), fiable et orienté(e) résultats ;
  • Disponible au moins trois jours par semaine ;
  • Numéro SIRET valide au démarrage.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Échange téléphonique avec notre équipe recrutement ;
  2. Entretien avec le ou la référente de votre secteur ;
  3. Décision rapide fondée sur votre expérience et votre motivation.

Envie de développer votre activité avec une rémunération sans plafond et des revenus récurrents potentiels ? Postulez dès maintenant !

jobs.title: Senior Manager- Commercial Performance Improvement
jobs.description:
About Unity Advisory

Unity Advisory is a modern advisory business built for today's CFO. It combines deep expertise with an AI-native operating model designed to deliver better evidence, faster execution and stronger client outcomes.

Through direct access to the expertise needed to solve complex challenges and a pace of delivery that enables organisations to seize opportunities, Unity delivers advisory as it should be, through a model that is free from audit conflict.

The Role

As a Senior Manager in our Deals and Value Capture team, you'll lead commercial performance improvement and value capture engagements for PE-backed and corporate clients across the deal and ownership lifecycle; from value-focused CDD and GTM diagnostics, through implementation and ongoing performance improvement, to exit readiness.

Our work spans the full commercial operating system: market, customer and value proposition; GTM model and channel strategy; marketing and sales effectiveness; pricing and monetisation; customer success, retention and expansion; commercial operations and Lead-to-Cash; and AI, analytics and data enablement. You'll bring these levers together into a practical, integrated plan rather than treating them as separate workstreams.

This is a hands-on delivery role. You'll lead workstreams day-to-day, build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and take ownership for moving from diagnosis to implementation. You'll also work closely with the Director/Partner group to shape the practice, feed in what is working on the ground and sharpen our proposition as we build it out.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end commercial performance improvement engagements, spanning value-focused GTM diagnostics, value capture execution, and ongoing performance improvement.

  • Diagnose where commercial value is created or lost using customer, commercial, operational and financial qualitative and quantitative data points; quantify the opportunity and link recommendations to revenue, margin, EBITDA and cash outcomes.

  • Design and deliver work across market segmentation, ICP and value proposition; GTM and channel strategy; marketing effectiveness; sales productivity, pipeline and forecasting; pricing and monetisation; and customer success, retention and expansion.

  • Help clients to build the commercial operating system required to sustain improvement, including GTM processes, commercial governance and operating cadence, and KPI definitions and incentives.

  • Translate analysis into execution through prioritised value cases, 100-day plans, pilots, playbooks, sales motions, adoption measures and benefits tracking, taking ownership for delivered outcomes, not just recommendations.

  • Create clear, decision-ready materials for management teams, boards and investors, including KPI baselines, performance dashboards, value creation roadmaps and diligence-ready evidence packs.

  • Manage day-to-day client relationships with senior stakeholders across commercial, finance, operations, technology and data, acting as the primary point of contact for engagement delivery.

  • Project manage multidisciplinary engagement teams, ensuring quality, pace and commercial impact while coaching and developing junior team members.

  • Contribute to proposals and pitches, including scoping, costing and drafting client-ready materials; identify follow-on opportunities within existing client relationships.

  • Develop Unity's commercial performance improvement IP, tools and methodology based on live engagement experience and reusable approaches across the portfolio.

Qualifications

  • 8-10 years of consulting or relevant industry experience in front-office, GTM, commercial transformation or performance improvement.

  • A track record of leading commercial transformation or value creation engagements from diagnosis through implementation, ideally including PE-backed portfolio company work.

  • Strong grounding across several commercial levers - for example GTM strategy, marketing or sales effectiveness, pricing, customer success, RevOps or Lead-to-Cash - with the judgement to connect them into an integrated answer.

  • Experience translating commercial strategy into practical operating models, processes, governance, performance cadence, capabilities and technology-enabled ways of working.

  • Strong analytical skills and confidence working with CRM, finance, marketing, customer and operational data to build value cases, identify performance drivers and track realisation.

  • Comfortable managing senior stakeholders, leading cross-functional teams and running complex workstreams with limited oversight.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex analysis into a clear client narrative, pragmatic choices and an executable plan.

  • Experience applying advanced analytics, automation or AI to commercial decision-making and workflows is advantageous.

  • Desirable: an existing network within the corporate mid-market or Private Equity, and experience working in a smaller, fast-moving advisory environment.

Work Environment

This is a hybrid role based out of London. You'll work with AI-native tools built into how we deliver, and get a level of exposure to how the practice is run that's hard to find at a larger firm.

Additional Information

At Unity Advisory, we are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. In line with the Equality Act 2010, we will accommodate any suitable candidate requiring assistance to attend or conduct an interview. Please let us know if you need any adjustments when scheduling your interview or in your cover letter.

PLEASE NOTE: We do not accept unsolicited CVs from third-party agencies.

Midnite is a next-generation sports betting and gaming platform built for a new wave of players.

We combine sharp product thinking, bold brand, and fast execution to create experiences that feel modern, intuitive, and built for how people actually play today.

Over 400,000 players have already made the move, and we’re only just getting started.

If you’re driven, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments where you can shape meaningful outcomes - keep reading.

Not your grandad’s bookie.

As a Sportsbook Trading Associate, you’ll play a key role in owning and delivering our In-Play Sportsbook proposition, ensuring we provide customers with a compelling, relevant, and engaging experience throughout the biggest sporting moments.

You’ll take ownership of key fixtures from start to finish, staying on top of match action, market suspensions, data feeds, pricing and settlement while ensuring the right markets, promotions and narrative-driven content are surfaced to customers at the right time.

A major focus of the role will be proactively identifying opportunities to grow Sportsbook handle and customer engagement. You’ll use your understanding of live sporting narratives to anticipate what customers will want to bet on next, making sure our proposition reacts quickly to what is happening on the pitch, court or track.

You’ll work closely with Trading, CRM, Product and Player Support to make our In-Play experience stand out, helping promote key fixtures and betting opportunities to our customer base while maintaining a consistently high operational standard.

This role is perfect for someone who lives and breathes sport, has an exceptional eye for detail, enjoys working in a fast-moving environment and wants to develop a strong understanding of sportsbook trading and customer behaviour.

  • Work closely with CRM and Product teams to ensure key fixtures, promotions and In-Play opportunities are communicated effectively and prominently to our customer base.

  • Help develop and execute real-time promotional opportunities, reacting quickly to match action and emerging narratives to keep the Sportsbook fresh and engaging.

  • Review performance and recurring operational issues across key fixtures, identifying opportunities to improve processes, proposition quality and the overall customer experience.

  • Support Trading and Product in continuously improving how we present and promote In-Play betting, helping build a proposition that gives customers more reasons to engage throughout an event rather than simply at kick-off.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, live environment, managing multiple priorities and reacting quickly as sporting events unfold.

  • A proactive mindset, someone who doesn’t just wait for issues or opportunities to be highlighted, but actively looks for ways to improve the proposition and drive customer engagement.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, being able to engage with stakeholders around our promotions at the relevant time.

jobs.description:
Note: Partly is headquartered in Austin, TX with offices in London, UK, Christchurch, NZ and Auckland, NZ. Wherever you're based, we'll connect you with your nearest office for onboarding, and fly you to join the full team for our quarterly "Season Openers" (we cover travel and accommodation). If you're relocating to join us, we can also assist with relocation costs.

🚀 Our story

Partly is connecting the world's parts, and we're doing that by building the AI infrastructure layer for the global repair industry, starting with the $2tn automotive market. Our frontier model, Interpreter, is the world's first AI purpose-built to understand vehicle damage and the parts needed to fix it. Thousands of businesses across the global repair supply chain already rely on it.

Founded by ex-Rocket Lab engineers, we've tripled in size in the last 18 months and have recently raised a $50m Series B led by DST Global (Anthropic, Airbnb, Meta, TikTok, Spotify) and including Blackbird Ventures (Canva, CultureAmp etc.), WNDR, Activant Capital, Icehouse Ventures, Square Peg, Airtree, and Ecliptic Venture Capital. We're headquartered in Austin, with offices in New Zealand and London.

We're continuing to build a world-class team ensuring Partly is a place where people can do the best work of their lives. We're proud of the culture we've built, and our values are lived throughout every experience.

Want to learn more about the problems we're solving and the culture we're building at Partly? Hear directly from our team here: https://shorturl.at/iAFUX

🖍️ This role

This is a forward-deployed solutions role at the front line of Partly's European expansion. You'll be the technical engine behind new-market deals across the UK and the Nordics, turning messy real-world problems into signed pilots and putting genuinely differentiated AI in front of the people who run the repair industry.

Here's what you'd be working with. Partly runs two connected layers. Partly.com is the infrastructure platform, the B2B layer that powers parts data, cataloging, and procurement across hundreds of integrations globally. Partly.ai is the AI tool for repairers, built on top of that infrastructure, that makes finding and sourcing the right part feel like magic. Both are powered by Interpreter, Partly's proprietary foundation model for understanding automotive parts at scale, trained on licensed OEM build data across 52+ manufacturer agreements and continuously sharpened by feedback from thousands of users across our global network. No general-purpose AI model comes close on parts accuracy, and that is what makes agentic procurement automation possible at the precision the repair industry demands.

Your job is to deploy that into markets we haven't cracked yet. Automotive data is scattered around the world in complex, inconsistent formats, and the interesting work is in unifying it into something that drives a customer's business. You'll sit between Sales, Product, and Engineering, resolving the technical blockers that stand between a prospect and a deal, building demos and experimental features that show off what Interpreter can do, and shaping how the product gets built for and applied to each new market.

Why join now: Partly closed a $50M Series B at a $500M valuation and is scaling fast across the UK, Europe, the U.S., and Australasia, in a $1.9 trillion industry that has barely been touched by modern software. You'd be early, close to the founders and the model, and given real ownership from day one. jobs.title: Head of Quality Engineering
jobs.description:
About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s newest unicorns with a team of just over 700 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the role

Quality at Lendable is a team-level responsibility with participation from PMs, EMs and engineers to ensure the right guardrails are in place to deliver quality software. We aggressively automate across the whole test pyramid and only manually test where absolutely necessary.

We’re hiring a Head of Quality to be accountable for engineering quality across the organisation, while local responsibility for delivering quality stays with each team. As we grow in headcount and customer numbers, this role keeps the bar high by taking signals from our existing quality processes, evolving our quality gates, and enabling teams rather than gatekeeping them. It is a hands-on role with a managerial aspect.

The role will take the lead on using AI in the quality process. Innovating with LLMs to improve efficiency and accuracy of testing.

What good looks like: in your first 12 months:

  • Reduction in incident rate per PR.

  • SLO coverage across services meaningfully increases.

  • Introduction of effective AI-assisted quality tooling in the SDLC.

  • Effective risk based quality reporting on quality.


What you'll be doing

Own the engineering quality of the organisation

Service Level Objectives

  • Monitor and report on SLO performance.

  • Engage teams to mature their SLO definitions.

  • Introduce systematic performance testing in the SDLC.

  • Ensure initiatives to improve SLO performance are completed.

Incidents

  • Own the follow-ups and resolutions from the incident process across engineering.

  • Ensure follow ups from incidents are completed.

From these and other sources Identify hotspots, catalogue and evaluate risks and recommend remediations.


How you’ll do this

Being Hands-on

This is not a pure managerial role. You will be engaging with teams, innovating with testing solutions and contributing code to test frameworks and CI pipelines..

Managing a team

  • Hiring and managing a team of ~2 Quality Engineers, they will be new hires to the company.

  • Deploying Quality Engineers into engineering teams to help them improve their quality.

  • Managing and supporting individuals that are embedded into different teams across the organisation

Driving a Quality Mindset

  • Evangelising quality across the organisation.

  • Work with MDs and other senior stakeholders to identify and create solutions to their quality challenges.

  • Embedding quality thinking into all phases of the SDLC, not just the testing part.

  • Looking for opportunities to shift-left the testing practices.

  • Forming a guild of Quality representatives across the organisation.

Running Initiatives

  • Scoping and inserting quality initiatives onto teams roadmaps.

  • Championing these initiatives with senior stakeholders

Developing the use of AI into the quality process

Bring tools and processes into the organisation to level-up our testing efficiency using AI. AI testing agents, AI test failure triage agents and AI observers for production environments.


Tech stacks you will be working with

Backend Coding: PHP, Kotlin, GO, Python
Frontend Coding: Typescript, React, React Native, GraphQL, Relay

Testing: PHPUnit, Behat, JUnit, Kotest, Jest, Maestro, K6

Observability: Datadog, Sentry, Incident.io, Grafana

Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ

Deployment: Argo, Github, Github Actions


What we're looking for

Essential

  • At least 7 years in quality related roles.

  • Run a number of QA initiatives across an organisation to improve the quality output across engineering teams.

  • Proven senior stakeholder management.

  • Experience working with quality across the stack. You have hands-on experience of testing backends and frontends. From functional to unit, performance and accessibility testing.

  • Have line managed a small team.

  • Worked with B2C products at scale (millions of users).

  • Experience shaping CI/CD pipelines for test reliability (GitHub Actions or similar), including flakiness reduction, parallelisation, artefact management, and runtime control.

  • Have shipped AI tooling into a quality process — this can be as simple as evaluating, buying and rolling out an off-the-shelf AI testing tool, through to building bespoke agents. You can describe the impact it had on how teams worked.

  • Proactive, low-ego, and clear communicator, able to chase things down when blocked.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with using Datadog, Sentry or similar for monitoring.

  • Experience with incident.io or similar incident process.

  • Have managed SLOs and used them to improve quality.

  • Experience in financial services or other regulated B2C environments.

  • Mobile app testing experience (e.g. Maestro, native iOS/Android, React Native).


Why join?

See your work matter: Our products are used by millions of customers. Improving quality ensures issues and outages don’t affect a large population across continents. Quality issues also have a direct impact on company revenue. As we scale further, quality plays a big part in our growth.

High autonomy: You will decide where and how to engage across the organisation to improve quality. You will hire a team of Quality Engineers to deploy into teams.

Work at the frontier of AI: AI tooling for quality is moving fast. You'll be one of the people deciding how we apply it - what's useful, what isn't, and where to have humans in the loop.

An organisation that ships: No layers, no theatre, fast decisions. A fast moving environment that has made the company successful.

Interview process

  1. Screening Call with the Talent Team

  2. Hiring Manager Call

  3. VP of Engineering Call

  4. Technical Interview

  5. Final stage with our CTO

Life at Lendable

  • Winning team: the opportunity to scale up one of the world’s most successful fintech companies

  • Flexible working: flexible approach tailored to each role. Hybrid roles require three days in-office weekly; fully remote roles include regular opportunities for in-person connection through socials and off-sites

  • Socials & connection: opportunities and events to come together, socialise, and get to know each other beyond the office walls

  • Health coverage: support for your physical and mental wellbeing, including private health cover

  • Retirement & savings: long-term financial wellbeing through retirement savings plans

  • Employee referral programme: earn a competitive bonus when you refer successful new team members

  • Office meals & snacks: enjoy a fully stocked kitchen, plus complimentary lunches prepared by in-house chefs on in-office days at select locations

  • Sustainable commuting: cycle-to-work and electric vehicle salary sacrifice schemes available in select locations

Please note: The availability and details of specific benefits vary by location and role. For more information, please speak to your Talent Partner.

Check out our blog!

jobs.title: Projektledare - Industrialisering till flygindustrin
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och forma hur framtidens flygplan produceras och modifieras? Som projektledare mot industrialisering får du en bred och operativ roll där du driver utvecklingen från idé till implementering och arbetar nära produktion och utveckling.

Om rollen
Som projektledare mot industrialisering arbetar du med att utveckla och effektivisera hur produktion och modifiering av flygplan genomförs. Du arbetar nära verksamheten och har många kontaktytor mot bland annat produktion, design och andra gränssnittsfunktioner, där du driver industrialiseringsarbetet från idé och planering till implementering.

I rollen ansvarar du för att ta fram och utveckla underlag, arbetssätt och lösningar som skapar en mer effektiv verksamhet. Det kan exempelvis handla om att definiera hur flygplan, verktyg och arbetsstationer ska utformas och placeras för att skapa ett effektivt produktions- och modifieringsflöde. Du arbetar även med layoutfrågor, processutveckling, administration och analyser av nuläget för att identifiera förbättringsområden och driva förändringsarbete.

En viktig del av arbetet är att koordinera och hantera gränssnitt mellan olika funktioner och verksamhetsområden för att säkerställa att lösningar fungerar genom hela kedjan, från design till produktion. Du kommer att arbeta i nära samarbete med verksamheten och ha en operativ roll där du omsätter behov till praktiska och hållbara lösningar.

Du arbetar i långsiktiga projekt som ofta sträcker sig över flera år. Rollen tillhör ett team som förstärks med flera projektledare med olika inriktningar inom bland annat produktion, design och gränssnittshantering, vilket ger möjlighet till ett nära samarbete och kunskapsutbyte mellan olika kompetensområden.

Din profil
För att lyckas i rollen som projektledare tror vi att du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med industrialisering inom industrin samt har en högskoleutbildning eller civilingenjörsexamen inom maskinteknik, produktutveckling eller produktion. Som person är du kommunikativ och har lätt för att samarbeta med olika funktioner. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor och kräver att du kan skapa förståelse och driva arbetet framåt tillsammans med andra. Du är också operativ i ditt arbetssätt och trivs med att vara nära verksamheten och se till att lösningar faktiskt implementeras och fungerar i praktiken.

Krav för tjänsten:

    Erfarenhet av projektledning och industrialisering inom tillverkande industrin

    Högskoleingenjörs/Civilingenjörsexamen inom maskinteknik, industriell ekonomi eller motsvarande

    Svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

Uppdraget är placerat i säkerhetsklass. Inför anställning krävs att du genomgår en säkerhetsprövning och godkänns enligt gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. Detta kan medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.  

Meriterande för tjänsten:

    Erfarenhet av industrialisering inom flygbranschen

Vår kund
Vår kund är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att stärka nationers förmåga att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. De utvecklar teknik och lösningar som stödjer en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. De utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapenteknik, ledningssystem, sensorer samt marina plattformar och utgör en viktig del av Sveriges och andra nationers försvarsförmåga.

Om Framtiden AB
Framtiden är ett rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag med kontor på åtta orter i Sverige. Vi finns för att fler ska älska måndagar! Inom Tech People är vi experter på ingenjörer, med roller för både juniora och seniora profiler inom IT och teknik. Inom Business People är vi experter på ekonomer på alla erfarenhetsnivåer, från specialister, chefer och interimsledare till juniora talanger inom ekonomi/finans, HR, lön och administration.

jobs.title: Pre-sales - Network and Cybersecurity, Stockholm - Hybrid
jobs.description:
Pre-sales - Network and Cybersecurity

Stockholm - Hybrid

The company is hiring a customer-facing Solution Architect into its Swedish presales team. This is a technical advisory and solution design role sitting at the front of the sales cycle — not a delivery or implementation seat. The person owns the technical relationship from first needs analysis through to solution proposal, and stays involved after signature to confirm the customer got the value they bought.

The technical center of gravity is networking, with security layered on top: network security, Zero Trust, segmentation and firewalls, cloud networking and SASE/SSE. Cisco and Palo Alto Networks are the two vendor platforms that matter most, with Cisco Meraki called out specifically.

A Cisco Preferred and Palo Alto Diamond Innovator partner, PE-backed and consolidating Europe, wants someone who is strong on networks and curious about security to sit in front of Sweden's most business-critical customers and design what they should buy — with a specialist bench of 1,700+ behind them and no delivery backlog on their calendar.

What you actually will work with

• Identify customers' business and technical needs at the front of the cycle

• Produce solution architectures, recommendations and product/service proposals

• Lead technical customer dialogues, presentations and workshops

• Support tenders, larger deals and strategic projects

• Follow up delivered solutions to confirm the customer realized the intended value

• Contribute to developing offerings and managed services

• Represent the company externally — customer events, seminars, market activity

Non-negotiables

• A genuine networking foundation — routing/switching, wireless, WAN. This is the floor; everything else is learnable on the job.

• Understanding of how networking intersects with security, cloud and data center

• Demonstrable comfort in front of customers. They must be able to hold a room containing both a skeptical CCIE and a CIO.

• The translation instinct: turning technical understanding into a recommendation a customer can act on and a business case they can defend internally.

• Swedish language is a must + English fluency

• Clean background check, the final candidate will be background checked.

Deep in at least two of: Cisco enterprise networking/Firewalls, Meraki, Palo Alto NGFW, SASE/SSE, segmentation/Zero Trust.
