jobs.title: AI Manager (m/w/d) (KI-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Willst du KI in echten geschäftlichen Mehrwert für die DLG verwandeln? Als **AI Manager (m/w/d)** spielst du eine zentrale Rolle in der Group IT. Du bist dafür verantwortlich, die KI‑Strategie der DLG weiterzuentwickeln und umzusetzen – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen. In dieser Rolle treibst du nicht nur die Richtung und Umsetzung von KI‑Initiativen voran, sondern baust auch ein Team von KI‑Spezialist*innen auf und führst es. Du schaffst die Grundlage dafür, wie wir KI‑Lösungen entwickeln, skalieren und im gesamten Unternehmen betreiben.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

Du prägst die KI‑Ausrichtung der DLG und leitest ein Team, das wirkungsvolle, geschäftsorientierte Lösungen liefert. Konkret bedeutet das:

- Du definierst und verantwortest die KI‑Roadmap sowie das Use‑Case‑Portfolio über alle Geschäftsbereiche hinweg.
- Du baust ein Team von KI‑Spezialist*innen auf, führst und entwickelst es weiter.
- Du übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in skalierbare und wirkungsvolle KI‑Lösungen.
- Du steuerst das Solution Design – von der Idee über Architekturentscheidungen bis zur Implementierung.
- Du etablierst Standards für Daten, Integrationen, Sicherheit, Skalierbarkeit und Responsible AI.
- Du arbeitest eng mit technischen Teams, externen Partnern und Dienstleistern zusammen, um Fortschritt und Qualität sicherzustellen.
- Du unterstützt Build-or-Buy‑Entscheidungen und sorgst für die Abstimmung mit den Enterprise‑Plattformen.

Profil

Du bist eine erfahrene **Führungskraft (m/w/d)** mit einer starken technischen Basis und einer Leidenschaft dafür, sowohl Menschen als auch Lösungen weiterzuentwickeln. Du arbeitest strukturiert und pragmatisch und erzielst Ergebnisse sowohl durch dein Team als auch durch deine eigene Expertise. Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen Business und IT und weißt, wie man Richtung, Alignment und Momentum in einem komplexen Stakeholder‑Umfeld schafft.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du:

- nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Teams im Bereich KI, Daten oder Advanced Analytics mitbringen
- ein tiefes Verständnis für Solution Architecture und komplexe IT‑Landschaften haben
- Erfahrung darin haben, KI‑ oder Dateninitiativen von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung zu treiben
- in der Lage sein, geschäftliche Prioritäten mit technologischen Möglichkeiten zu verbinden
- Erfahrung mit Governance, Priorisierung und funktionsübergreifenden Entscheidungen haben
- eine starke Führungspersönlichkeit sein, die motiviert, coacht und Engagement schafft
- strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert arbeiten
- klar kommunizieren und komplexe Themen verständlich machen
- sicher in Deutsch und Englisch kommunizieren

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG erwartet dich eine spannende und wirkungsvolle Rolle in einem Unternehmen, in dem KI und Digitalisierung ganz oben auf der Agenda stehen.

Du kannst dich freuen auf:

- eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung der KI‑Ausrichtung eines internationalen Unternehmens
- die Möglichkeit, eine neue KI‑Funktion innerhalb der DLG aufzubauen und zu führen
- ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung und Einfluss
- ein starkes professionelles Umfeld in IT, Daten und Digitalisierung
- persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten
- flexible Arbeitsbedingungen und eine gesunde Work‑Life‑Balance

Kontakt

Wir freuen uns über deine Bewerbung im PDF-Format über unser Bewerbungsportal unter Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und des frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins.

jobs.description:
Experience the power of a game-changing career  

Want to be part of an innovative and growing team? We’re a global technology and services leader that powers the brands of the future. We help well-known brands — the ones you use every day — improve their businesses with technology and integrated solutions, in over 70 countries.  

If you’re looking to grow and be inspired, as an Account Manager Executive, you will be part of our team of game-changers who are powering the brands of the future in tech.  

Career growth and personal development  

This is a great opportunity to experience the power of what’s next and develop “friends for life” at the same time. We’ll give you all the training, cutting-edge technologies, and the continuing support you’ll need to succeed.  

What you will do in this role  

In everything we do, we believe in doing right by and for people – our clients, their customers, our people, our community, and our planet.  

As an Account Manager Executive on our team, you will:  

- Focus on developing and closing opportunities with both new and existing customers, driving acquisition, retention, and growth across mid-sized accounts.
- Own the overall account strategy and sales execution.
- Systematically qualify customer potential and address whitespace opportunities across the full product portfolio.
- Collaborate closely with the Channel team (PBM, iPBM, Proximity) to align account strategies.
- Drive PC++ Sales (including Headsets, Displays, and Care Packs) as well as Print Transactional Sales.

- Identify and engage new contacts within assigned accounts, elevate relationships across the full portfolio, and manage structured communications based on strategic sequencing.
- Own opportunity identification, qualification, and management. Proactively hunt within low or no SOW accounts.
- Coordinate with in-market technical consultants to provide expert support when required.
- Support or lead project management efforts, own pricing discussions, ensure compliance with global pricing guidelines, and manage negotiations and sales closure with a focus on profitability.
- Support renewals and post-sales activities in partner-led opportunities, offering guidance on cross-sell and upsell strategies based on customer needs, and ensuring an outstanding customer experience.

Your qualifications  

We embrace our game-changers with open arms, people from diverse backgrounds, who are curious and willing to learn. Your natural talent to help others and go beyond WOW for our customers will fit right in with what we do and who we are.  

Concentrix is a great match if you:  

- Are proficient or bilingual in German with advanced English level
- Have proven ability to self-prospect via cold outreach using multiple contact tools.
- Are skilled in building strong relationships with decision-makers.
- Are capable of navigating complex organizations to identify expansion opportunities.
- Are experienced in leading meetings with IT and Procurement stakeholders.
- Have strong business acumen with the ability to develop long-term growth strategies.

Don’t meet every requirement? No worries. We’re dedicated to creating a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace for everyone. If you feel you don’t check every box, we still encourage you to apply. We’ll do our best to match you with the right job, whether it’s this one or another role.  

What’s in it for you  

We challenge conventions to deliver outcomes unimagined by creating customer experiences that go beyond WOW. That’s why we significantly invest in our people, our infrastructure, and our capabilities to ensure long-term success for our teams, our customers, and YOU.  

In this role, we offer benefits that help support your **unique lifestyle:**

jobs.title: German speaking Google Ads Sales Executive (m/w/d), Barcelona Spain (Sales-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Join a dynamic team as a Google Ads Sales Executive, where you’ll drive growth for our valued clients. We’re seeking a resilient individual to focus on providing exceptional service-oriented Google Ads solutions to emerging businesses and established local enterprises. If you have a proven sales track record, excel at building relationships quickly, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

- Engage with regional clients, understanding their needs and providing tailored service solutions.
- Manage a high volume of accounts, focusing on delivering exceptional service and sales support.
- Drive revenue growth by effectively selling and convincing clients, using strong sales techniques.
- Work with performance targets and KPIs to consistently meet or exceed objectives.
- Quickly adapt to changing customer needs and business priorities.
- Cultivate relationships with clients, ensuring their satisfaction and fostering long-term loyalty.
- Provide excellent customer service, addressing inquiries, concerns, and providing timely resolutions.

Requirements

- C2 level of German and C1 level of English (both written and spoken).
- 2 years of proven sales experience, with the ability to win people over and convince clients rapidly.
- Proficient at creating digital marketing strategies for all customers sizes.
- Education: BA/BS degree required; Master’s degree or advanced professional certification is highly desirable.
- High-Impact Target Attainment: Extensive history of consistently achieving and surpassing challenging sales quotas. Must possess deep expertise in persuasive negotiation and a demonstrated capacity for driving significant individual revenue and market share gains in high-velocity sectors of different verticals. Proficient resilience and ability to handle a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
- Advanced Client Advocacy: Significant experience as a senior, customer-facing subject matter expert, specifically designing and implementing service protocols that resolve systemic client friction and substantially enhance customer retention and lifetime value.
- Operational Versatility: Exceptional ability to thrive through periods of ambiguity and rapid change, swiftly implementing process improvements and recalibrating priorities to ensure continuous business momentum.

Specialized Skills for the German Market:

- Deep German market and cultural understanding.
- Strategic thinking to target high-growth companies.
- Strong problem-solving, analytical, and relationship-building skills.
- Ability to unlock substantial expansion opportunities.
- German cultural awareness for building client trust.
- Stakeholder management, including skeptical clients and multiple agencies.
- Deep understanding of the German digital marketing ecosystem to position Google Ads effectively.
- Proficiency in managing sophisticated ROI and integration queries.
- Knowledge of local regulations, especially GDPR, to ensure compliance and tailor data-privacy-focused outreach strategies.

Desirable Skills

- Process Excellence: Systematically improving organizational processes to enhance efficiency, effectiveness, and quality
- Collaboration: Working effectively with others, sharing ideas and resources to achieve common goals
- Communication: Exchanging information, ideas, and messages between individuals or groups through various channels and mediums.
- Emotional Intelligence: Understanding and managing one’s own emotions and the emotions of others to foster positive relationships and enhance the impact of actions
- Open Mindedness: Considering and appreciating diverse perspectives and ideas, fostering collaboration
- Critical Thinking: Evaluating information and arguments, leading to informed and effective decisions based on data insights
- Solution Orientation: Approaching problems and challenges with a focus on finding practical and effective solutions
- Entrepreneurship: Having a mindset characterized by innovation, creativity, risk-taking, and a proactive approach to problem-solving and opportunity identification

Benefits

- Full-time (39 hours/week) hybrid position in Barcelona with a salary of 24.310,00 € gross/year + up to 4.290,00 € gross/year in bonus.
- Relocation Support
- Private Health Insurance.
- Continuous skill development and certifications.
- Clear career growth opportunities
- Engaging workplace with bi-weekly, monthly, or quarterly contests and dynamic business casual culture.
- Prime office location at the World Trade Center, Barcelona, surrounded by the sea.

jobs.title: (Senior) Risk Manager (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.employer: Commerz Real AG Commerz Real Düsseldorf
jobs.description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten

jobs.title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

jobs.title: Data Analyst (m/f/d) - Data Team (Mid Level)
jobs.description:
Big thinking. Serious doing.
... 1 Data Analyst (m/f/d) - Data Team (Mid Level) We are looking for a Data Analyst with 3-5 years of experience to join our data team in Vienna. You will own the analytics layer in our client and venture projects, across three kinds of work: product analytics for the digital products we build, commercial analytics for new services and business models, and investment and portfolio analytics for our (Corporate) Venture Capital and Investment clients. You will work alongside our data engineers and get hands-on with the pipelines and models behind your dashboards.

Your Responsibilities

* Set up product analytics: tracking concepts, funnels, retention and cohort analyses.
* Build commercial analytics for new services, including unit economics, pricing, contribution margin, adoption and revenue.
* Develop data models and reporting for portfolio monitoring, performance tracking and investment decisions.
* Write and optimise SQL for data models, transformations and analyses.
* Support data pipelines and transformation layers: build models, test, resolve quality issues and extend flows.
* Build and maintain useful Power BI dashboards for product, portfolio and commercial KPIs.
* Define business metrics with stakeholders and align analytics with strategic goals.
* Improve data quality, documentation and governance.
* Own your workstream, priorities, timelines and dependencies; coordinate with engineers, PMs and clients.
* Turn requirements into documented solutions and share learnings across Trinsik.

Your Requirements/Qualifications

* 3-5 years' experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst, Analytics Engineer or similar.
* Strong SQL skills, including joins, CTEs, window functions and query performance.
* Strong Power BI skills in data modelling, DAX, Power Query and reporting, or comparable BI tools.
* Sound knowledge of dimensional modelling, relational databases and ETL/ELT.
* Hands-on product analytics and event tracking experience with GA4, Amplitude, Mixpanel, PostHog or similar.
* Understanding of activation, retention, cohorts, funnels, unit economics, CAC/LTV, contribution margin and pricing.
* Self-organised and able to structure unclear requirements and drive delivery independently.
*  Confident presenting results to clients.
* Analytical, solution-oriented mindset and strong communication skills.
* IT-related education or equivalent qualification.
* Excellent English; German is a plus.

Nice to have

* Investment or financial data experience, including portfolio analytics or fund reporting.
* Experience with Azure, Fabric, dbt, Snowflake or a similar modern data stack.
* Python for data work.

Your Benefits

* Salary: €55,000-€65,000 gross per year, based on competencies.
* Daily perk: Public transport subsidy or tax-free lunch allowance.
* Discounts: Offers from 600+ brands via Corporate Benefits.
* Flexibility: Flexible hours and home office.
* Remote work: Up to 20 days per year within the EU, plus sabbatical options.
* Variety: Different industries, apps and digital solutions with creative freedom.
* Modern tools: Current software and openness to better solutions.
* International team: Colleagues across Austria, Germany, Hungary and Switzerland.
* Culture: Flat hierarchies and open, direct feedback.
* Location: Collaborative workplace in central Vienna.

Our Process

Our three-stage process gives both sides a clear picture. We position the role by competencies, not titles.

* 01 Chemistry & culture: 30 min virtual with Maria, Head of People
* 02 Technical skills: 60 min in person with Yun and Peti, Data Team
* 03 Founder conversation: 30 min virtual with Georg, Managing Partner

jobs.title: Contract Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
1 Contract Manager (m/f/d) Job ID 520262

Siemens Mobility location in 1110 Vienna.
You will analyse, draft and evaluate customer and supplier contracts, identify relevant opportunities and risks during project management and advise the project teams competently on contract-related issues.

* In addition, you will support the creation, negotiation and enforcement of amendments vis-à-vis customers and suppliers, ensuring the documentation and prosecution of claims as part of claim management.
* You will analyze project deviations in terms of costs, deadlines and scope of services, carry out delay analyses and evaluate the causes and effects of schedule deviations.
* In doing so, you will identify, document and assert downtime, obstructions and productivity losses and support the project teams in preparing evidence to enforce additional costs and compensation claims.
* You will work closely with the areas of project management, commercial management, engineering, procurement and legal counsel and accompany negotiations as well as the out-of-court or judicial enforcement of claims.


Your qualifications - solid and relevant

* You have successfully completed a university degree in law or an economic/technical university degree with basic legal training.
* You have a special interest and in-depth knowledge of contract law and ideally have already gained 3-5 years of professional experience in contract management, claim management or project management in the context of complex infrastructure or rolling stock projects.
* You have a pronounced willingness to familiarize yourself with the technical details of infrastructure projects in order to form an effective interface between law and technology.
* You are very interested in using AI to increase the quality and efficiency of your work.
* Personally, you are characterized by a structured, analytical way of working, initiative, strong communication skills and enjoyment of interdisciplinary cooperation.
* You are willing to travel nationally and internationally.
* Since you work in an international project environment, you are fluent in both written and spoken German and English. Ideally, you also have excellent knowledge of Romanian or another Eastern European language.

What do we offer you?

* Internationality - We offer an attractive working environment in an innovative, globally active group with diverse and responsible tasks in an international environment
* Purpose - We are pioneers of mobility. With us, you are actively contributing to the transport turnaround and climate protection in a market of the future, because our transport solutions reduce CO2 emissions all over the world.
* Reconciling family and career - With flexible working hours and the possibility of working from home, we help you to concentrate fully on your career without losing sight of the demands of your family life.
* Attractive conditions - You will receive an attractive remuneration package within the framework of the Collective Agreement for the Electrical and Electronics Industry of Austria and other extras such as employee share programmes and company pension schemes.
* Further development - We offer you comprehensive training opportunities for your professional and personal development, both online and offline.
* Team - Become part of our highly committed and collaborative team.

What else do I need to know?We offer an attractive compensation package that reflects your qualifications and professional experience. The gross annual salary for this position, as defined by the applicable collective agreement, is at least EUR 65,041.34. Depending on your education and experience, a higher salary may be offered. As a large international corporation, Siemens also provides additional benefits and social perks.
How can I apply?If you are interested in this position, we look forward to receiving your detailed online application.

jobs.description:
We grew from $1M to $10M ARR in under 12 months and now serve 10,000+ customers.

Fonio is Europe's market leader for AI phone agents for SMBs. Now were expanding globally and into new products.

We move fast, take ownership, give direct feedback, and avoid politics and unnecessary meetings.

Join one of Europe's fastest-growing companies. 1 Marketing Engineer Your Role

As our Marketing Engineer, you sit at the intersection of data science and paid media. You'll consolidate scattered customer signals into a single source of truth, build ML models that score leads by their real value, and feed those insights back into our ad platforms - making our marketing smarter than the platforms' out-of-the-box optimization. jobs.title: Senior QA Analyst
jobs.description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.
Double work station setup and flexible work environment.
An active fun division that hosts regular events.
An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.
Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.
Annual sports grant.
A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.
Home internet.
A conditional monthly transportation grant.
Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.
On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.
Relocation Package.

Please submit your application in English.

Please apply by filling in an online application here: https://careers.fenriscreations.com/en/postings/d315eb37-715d-4657-b29d-484420749257
Application deadline 8th of october 2026

jobs.description:
Chez IPSI, c'est C.A.A.R.Ré

CONFIANCE / AUTHENTICITE / AVENTURE HUMAINE / RECONNAISSANCE / REUSSITE

Nos valeurs guident notre quotidien et nous vous invitons à embarquer dans cette aventure palpitante avec nous !

Depuis plusieurs années, notre FIRST Académie a ouvert ses portes à divers talents avec pour objectifs de les former et de les intégrer dans nos équipes !  
De 2018 à aujourd'hui, pour 125 apprenants intégrés, c'est 86% de taux de satisfaction, 86% de réussite au TP et 92% de taux d'insertion dans l'emploi.

Les objectifs de la formation :

- Assurer la traçabilité des opérations effectuées et le conseil du client à l'issue d'une intervention

La formation allie cours théoriques et stage pratique sur site. Lors de son cursus, l'apprenant est accompagné d'un tuteur.

A l'issue de la formation, nous vous embaucherons en tant que technicien de maintenance SSI en CDI avec une période d'essai de 3 mois. Durant cette période, vous continuerez à être accompagné(e) afin de faciliter votre montée en compétences et votre intégration.

Disposer de connaissances et savoirs faire en électricité / électrotechnique, à minima un Bac pro MELEC ou acquis par l'expérience

Une bonne communication orale et écrite
Une bonne aisance relationnelle et le sens des responsabilités
Etre inscrit.e à France Travail

Un échange téléphonique avec notre Chargé.e de recrutement
Des tests de prérequis (électricité et logique) et un entretien de motivation en face à face
La validation de votre candidature

La formation se déroulera en Île-de-France. Pour les candidats résidant hors de la région, un hébergement sera mis à disposition durant toute la durée de la formation au sein du centre de formation. Ensemble, remplissons notre devoir avec détermination et passion !

jobs.title: Public Sector Enablement Lead
Commercial Counsel
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


We're seeking an experienced Commercial Counsel to join our growing legal team and serve as a strategic partner to our rapidly expanding enterprise sales organization. In this high-impact role, you'll drive complex commercial negotiations that fuel our growth, working closely with our sales teams to close sophisticated technology agreements with enterprise customers across diverse industries. You'll play a critical role in scaling our commercial legal processes while navigating the evolving landscape of AI-powered development tools and ensuring our customers can confidently deploy Replit's platform in their organizations.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Drive Enterprise Deals: Serve as the lead legal advisor for complex, high-value enterprise sales transactions, working directly with our Account Executives and customer legal teams to negotiate and close sophisticated software agreements

 - Navigate AI & Technology Compliance: Help enterprise customers understand and navigate the legal and regulatory implications of adopting AI-powered development tools, addressing data privacy, security, and compliance requirements across various industries

 - Build Scalable Frameworks: Design and implement contract playbooks, template agreements, and streamlined processes that enable our sales team to move quickly while maintaining legal rigor as we scale

jobs.title: Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique (H/F)

Rejoindre le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR

Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Chargé(e) d'Affaires Construction Métallique capable de suivre les projets de manière autonome, de coordonner les différents intervenants et de contribuer au développement commercial du groupe.
Votre mission
En lien direct avec la Direction, les équipes techniques et les partenaires du groupe, vous prenez en charge le suivi des affaires depuis l'analyse du besoin client jusqu'à la coordination de la réalisation.
Votre rôle consiste à faire le lien entre les clients, les bureaux d'études, les équipes commerciales, les partenaires techniques et les unités de production afin de garantir le bon déroulement des projets.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer (H/F)
jobs.description:
L'app Hello Watt, c'est 3 millions de téléchargements et plus d'1 million de foyers connectés. C'est l'app pour piloter l'énergie dans son logement, réduire ses factures et participer à la stabilité du réseau électrique via les marchés de la flexibilité. Chez Hello Watt nous électrifions également les logements en installant des panneaux solaires ou des pompes à chaleur partout en France.
Nous recherchons un Frontend Engineer, aussi à l'aise dans une application React web/TypeScript que dans une page server-rendered avec HTMX et AlpineJS, supporté par notre design system basé sur TailwindCSS.
Chez Hello Watt, le frontend est un pilier de l'expérience utilisateur : courbes de consommation, pilotage d'appareils en temps réel, parcours de souscription, design system partagé entre React et Django, tu seras au cœur de l'expérience de centaines de milliers de foyers, sur le web comme sur iOS et Android.
Nous sommes convaincus que l'IA transforme en profondeur le métier de développeurs-euses. Nous cherchons à garder une qualité de code et une facilité de maintenance élevés, tout en embrassant les nouvelles pratiques et workflows IA.
Tes missions :
- Faire vivre et évoluer Firebolt, notre design system (Tailwind + composants React et Django) en facilitant l'intégration et l'adoption par les développeurs-euses full-stack.

- Veiller à des temps de chargements rapides pour tous sur l'app et le site hellowatt.fr (SEO, Core Web Vitals).

- Implémenter le frontend de nouvelles fonctionnalités sur l'application Hello Watt (web/iOS/Android).

- Définir les pratiques et les outils communs du frontend, faire converger l'existant : data-fetching, formulaires, state management, conventions de composants côté Django/htmx.

- Maintenir un haut niveau de qualité sur le code, qu'il soit écrit à la main ou généré par IA via des revues exigeantes et la mise en place d'outils pour améliorer les agents IA.

- Élargir la couverture et les outils de tests du frontend : tests de composants et de hooks (Vitest, Testing Library), scénarios end-to-end (Playwright), Storybook.

Profil recherché
Nous cherchons des ingénieurs qui ne se concentrent pas uniquement sur l'implémentation: poser les bons problèmes, comprendre les utilisateurs-ices, et tenir l'architecture sur le long terme.
Compétences clés recherchées :
- Passion frontend : forte curiosité et veille active de son écosystème: supports des nouvelles fonctionnalités navigateurs, frameworks, tooling, patterns

- Problem solving : capacité à décomposer des problèmes complexes, identifier les vrais enjeux métier et faire les bons compromis techniques

- User & UX focus : sensibilité forte à l'expérience utilisateur et à la valeur livrée

- Architecture système : capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture web modulaire, scalable et maintenable

Compétences techniques recherchées :
- Expérience confirmée en développement frontend avec React et TypeScript, dans un environnement produit exigeant sur l'expérience utilisateur.

- À l'aise avec le rendu côté serveur et l'approche hypermedia: Templates Django, htmx, Alpine.js ou similaires.

- Habitué à travailler et/ou définir un design system.

- Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : typage & lint de code, tests unitaires et fonctionnels, documentation, revues de code, composition, architecture modulaire par domaines métier.

- Apprécié : notions de Python/Django pour naviguer entre vues et templates, expérience du mobile hybride (capacitorjs).

- Au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans un poste similaire.

- Bac +5 université ou équivalent

Autres compétences recherchées :
- Volonté de travailler sur des produits à impact

- Goût pour les belles choses

- Volonté de progresser, individuellement et en équipe

- Enthousiasme à explorer comment l'IA peut élever notre métier, nos produits et nos workflows

Environnement technique:
Frontend web app & native apps
- Language : TypeScript

- Framework: ReactJs

- Librairies: Tanstack Query, React Router, Lingui

- Styling : Firebolt, le design System Hello Watt. Construit avec Tailwind CSS, Radix ui, Storybook

- Approche hybride : Webviews intégrées via CapacitorJS (compatibilité iOS/Android)

Frontend Web
- Language : Django templating language & TypeScript

- Librairies: Htmx, Alpinejs

- Styling : Firebolt, le design System Hello Watt. Construit avec Tailwind CSS, Alpinejs, Storybook

Backend
- Language & Frameworks : Python avec Django (REST APIs, ORM, Admin)

- Bases de données : MySQL et MongoDB

Infrastructure & Déploiement
- Cloud Provider : AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, S3, RDS, etc.)

- CI/CD : GitLab CI pour l'intégration et le déploiement automatisés

Outils & Collaboration
- Gestion de projet : Linear (suivi des tâches, roadmap produit)

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Organizations & Cells
Junior kampagne specialist for Google Ads i Barcelona
jobs.description:
Er du klar til at forlade Danmark og det regnfulde vejr til fordel for den livlige, spændende og smukke by Barcelona? Og kunne du tænke dig at tilføje værdifuld arbejdserfaring med Google Ads til dit CV? Så er dette måske noget for dig!

Barcelona er hjemsted for mange store kunstnere og malere, så der er altid masser af kunst at udforske. Byens mest berømte kulturelle mesterværk er Gaudís værk, den imponerende katedral "Sagrada Familia," som repræsenterer en unik stil inden for moderne arkitektur.

Hvis du ikke er så vild med kunst og kultur, kan du tilbringe dagen på en af Barcelonas sandstrande, som kun ligger en kort gåtur fra byens centrum. Her kan du nyde noget af det bedste middelhavsinspirerede seafood. Byen har et ry for at være den mest kosmopolitiske, moderne og fremsynede by i Spanien. Selvom det er en meget moderne by, finder du stadig de gamle kvarterer som det gotiske kvarter, hvor byens ældste bygning ligger, samt utallige barer og butikker.

Vi tilbyder

  • Konkurrencedygtig lønpakke og bonussystem

  • Udviklingsmuligheder inden for virksomheden

  • En arbejdsplads med gode kolleger, sociale arrangementer og et kontor med havudsigt

  • Relocation-pakke (Betalt fly til Barcelona og den første måneds husleje betalt + økonomisk bolig støtte din anden måned)

  • Sundhedsforsikring

  • Gratis fitnessmedlemskab

  • Præstationsbonusser

Om jobbet:

Som junior kampagne- og marketingspecialist vil du være ansvarlig for at forbedre og udvikle kampagner. Derfor vil du skulle rådgive og have gode forhandlingsevner – det er ikke aggressivt salg, men det er vigtigt, at du besidder nogle salgsmæssige kvaliteter. Dit daglige arbejde vil inkludere opgaver som:

  • Fungere som en betroet konsulent og onboarde kunder

  • Udvikle PPC-kampagner

  • Forstå kundernes behov og mål

  • Ansvar for at øge forbrug, mersalg og bæredygtighed

  • Håndtere en stor mængde potentielle kunder dagligt via telefonopkald

Dine kvalifikationer

Du taler dansk på modersmålsniveau og er flydende i engelsk (B2).

Erfaring: Minimum 1-2 års erfaring inden for salg og/eller online annoncering. Erfaring med outbound-opkald og salg (ikke påkrævet). BA/BS i Marketing, Digital Marketing eller Kommunikation er et plus.

Du har en god forståelse og et solidt niveau af computerfærdigheder.

Fremragende problemløsningsevner med evnen til at finde og identificere de rette oplysninger. Du har erfaring med og en passion for online display-annoncering.

Stærke kommunikations- og forhandlingsevner. Du er serviceorienteret, professionel og grundig.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at sende en mail til Cll@jobsqd.com


Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Job Title : Rewinder Operative Location: Dublin Responsible to : Operations Manager Job Purpose : The role of the Rewinder Operative is to ensure the smooth running of the machine to meet the needs of our customers. Roles & Responsibilities: 1. To ensure all production to comply with customer requirements. 2. Adhere to adhere to GMP guidelines. 3. Confirm that line clearance procedures and quality checks have been completed as part of the first of approval process and adhered too. 4. Um er að ræða fjölbreytt og krefjandi starf í öflugu framleiðsluumhverfi þar sem gæði, þjónusta og fagmennska eru í fyrirrúmi.

Stýra og hafa umsjón með offsetprentvél.
Úttekt og samanburður prófarka og prentarka til að tryggja gæði framleiðslu.
Umsjón með viðhaldi véla og útfylling viðhaldsbókar.
Veita svör og ráðgjöf varðandi prentun og tæknileg atriði.
Umhirða og frágangur vinnuaðstöðu.
Önnur tilfallandi verkefni tengd starfssviðinu.

Reynsla af offsetprentun eða sambærilegri framleiðslu er kostur.
Góð tæknileg þekking og hæfni til að vinna sjálfstætt.
Nákvæmni, skipulagshæfni og öguð vinnubrögð.
Jákvætt viðhorf og góð samstarfshæfni.
Áhugi á gæðum og stöðugum umbótum.

Starfið fellur undir kjarasamning Grafíu.
Vinnutími er frá 08:00 til 16:00 virka daga, en til 15:30 á föstudögum.

Prentmet Oddi er stærsti framleiðandi landsins á kartonumbúðum, almennu prentverki og bókum. jobs.title: Service Desk Technician
jobs.description:
**Service Desk Technician**

JOB PURPOSE

Serve as the first point of contact for Curium employees and partners worldwide, providing timely, high-quality technical assistance through the Global Service Desk. Log, diagnose, resolve and/or escalate incidents and service requests in line with agreed SLAs, while contributing to knowledge and continuous service improvement.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE ROLE

- Provide first-line support via Freshservice, phone, chat and email; ensure accurate ticket creation and lifecycle updates.

- Troubleshoot and resolve incidents related to end-user devices, operating systems, Microsoft 365, collaboration tools and approved business applications.

- Fulfil service requests (software installation/configuration, access requests, equipment requests) following standard procedures and security policies.

- Support user onboarding/offboarding: account setup coordination, workstation readiness, and user guidance on core tools and security best practices.

- Use remote support tools to assist users; collaborate with local IT/field services when hands-on intervention is required.

- Escalate complex issues to the appropriate resolver groups (workplace, network, server, security, applications) with clear diagnostics and evidence.

- Create and maintain knowledge base articles, procedures and troubleshooting guides; contribute to reducing repeat incidents.

- Maintain accurate asset and user device records in Freshservice and ensure data quality for reporting and compliance.

- Communicate clearly and professionally with users, providing status updates and setting expectations throughout the resolution process.

- Participate in shift coverage and (where applicable) on-call/major incident support according to the Global Service Desk operating model.

- Backfill the field service desk technician on request.


WHAT YOU NEED FOR THIS POSITION

**Must have Experience/Skills:**

- Bachelor's degree in IT (or equivalent professional experience).

- 2+ years in a Service Desk / IT support role in an international environment.

- Demonstrated experience working with ITSM processes (Incident, Request, Knowledge) and SLAs.

- Strong troubleshooting skills on Windows and common end-user hardware/peripherals.

- Good knowledge of Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

- Familiarity with identity and access concepts (Active Directory / Entra ID), MFA and basic security hygiene.

- Experience with remote support tools and endpoint management basics (Intune / Autopilot / SCCM) is advantageous.

- Basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, WiFi, VPN, connectivity troubleshooting).

- Excellent customer service mindset; ability to prioritize and work under time pressure.

- Fluent in Finnish and English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus.


**Nice to have Experience/Skills:**

- Hands-on experience with Freshservice (or equivalent ITSM tool) including knowledge article creation.

- ITIL Foundation certification or practical ITIL experience.

- Experience supporting Teams telephony / conferencing room equipment.

- Exposure to regulated environments (GxP) and validated processes.

jobs.title: Experiment Support and Instrument Technician
jobs.description:
The company
The ILL is an international research facility at the forefront of neutron science and technology. Its High-Flux Nuclear Reactor delivers the world's most intense neutron beams to a suite of over 40 scientific instruments. Every year, some 1800 international researchers visit the ILL to carry out cutting-edge experiments across a range of scientific disciplines, driving innovation in the fields of health, energy, the environment and quantum materials. The ILL is also involved in the production of radioisotopes for medical applications. The ILL employs over 500 staff from 25 different countries, in a diversity of careers and a multicultural and inclusive environment.

The Science Division at ILL brings together close to 200 scientists, engineers, and technicians who work collaboratively to provide users with advanced experimental capabilities and expert scientific support. The DS is responsible by operating world-class neutron scattering instruments, supporting an international user community, conducting cutting-edge research, and developing new experimental techniques. In addition, the division drives the development of next-generation instrumentation and computational tools, fosters international collaborations, and contributes to advanced training.

About the position
As an experiment support and instrument technician, you will be responsible for the operation and development of experimental equipment and for providing support for experiments conducted at the ILL.
You will work closely with the scientists in charge of the instruments you will be assigned to. You will also collaborate with the other technicians in the Spectroscopy group. You will act as technical contact for the instrument WASP within this group. Depending on the needs of the different groups, you may be asked to work in parallel on other instruments within the Spectroscopy group.

Your tasks
Your main duties will involve the following:
-    Performing maintenance work and repairs on instruments and their ancillary equipment
-    Assisting in-house and visiting scientists with the preparation of their experiments
-    Designing new equipment in collaboration with ILL scientists and technical support groups
-    Improving the instruments and the way in which experiments are conducted by devising innovative technical solutions
-    Performing precision machining of simple mechanical parts (lathing, milling, drilling) at short notice
-    Installing, maintaining and operating sample environment equipment (cryostats, furnaces, etc.)
-    Organising the purchase of new equipment and spare parts

Desired profile
-    You have a Level 4/5 qualification (e.g. NVQ, BTEC HNC/HND or equivalent) in mechanical, maintenance or electronic engineering.
-    You have experience in the assembly and alignment of precision mechanical assemblies.
-    You have knowledge of CAD software.
-    Experience in scientific instrumentation, in particular in the field of cryogenics, would be an advantage.
-    You must have a sound knowledge of English and be willing to learn French (a language course will be paid for by the ILL).

Benefits
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

jobs.title: PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance
jobs.description:
PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance

Oslo Business School at Oslo Metropolitan University (OsloMet) invites applications for a temporary position as PhD scholar in long-term climate governance. The position is connected to the ERC-funded research project CAMELOT – Capacities for More Effective Long-term Climate Governance and is expected to start in April 2027.

The position is three years full-time but can be extended to four years if teaching assignments are included. The PhD Research Fellow will be based in the academic unit Public Administration and Governance at Oslo Business School and will be enrolled in OsloMet's PhD programme in Social Sciences, specialization Business Administration, Innovation and Governance (BIG).

The successful candidate is expected to complete the doctoral degree during the period of employment.


About CAMELOT

Many of today's most consequential governance challenges, including climate change and Earth system risks, unfold over decades, centuries, or longer. Yet political institutions and decision-making processes often struggle to engage effectively with such long-term futures.

CAMELOT investigates the capacities that enable individuals, groups, and institutions to think about and govern for the long term. The project develops new theory on long-term governance capacities and studies whether and how such capacities can be strengthened through experimental and participatory research. It brings together insights from political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, futures studies, psychology, and related fields.

CAMELOT is a five-year research project funded by a European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator Grant and led by Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit at OsloMet.

CAMELOT project website


About the PhD project

The PhD scholar will develop an independent research project that contributes to CAMELOT's overarching objective of understanding and strengthening capacities for long-term climate governance.

The project should be theoretically informed and empirically grounded and involve original empirical research designed and conducted by the PhD candidate. The research may build on, extend, or enable comparisons with research undertaken elsewhere in CAMELOT, but should not depend on data collection undertaken in other parts of the project.

We welcome innovative proposals addressing questions related to long-term governance capacities. Possible research directions include, but are not limited to:

  • investigating how narratives and stories about long-term climate futures influence imagination, understanding, attitudes, decision-making, or other capacities relevant to long-term governance
  • examining how engagement with long-term climate futures differs across climate risks, Earth system tipping elements, audiences, social groups, professional communities, or political and cultural contexts
  • studying how scenarios, foresight, simulations, serious games, or other futures-oriented interventions affect capacities for anticipatory and long-term governance
  • developing and evaluating educational or professional interventions designed to strengthen capacities for engaging with long-term climate futures
  • investigating whether and under what conditions changes in long-term governance capacities translate into changes in reasoning, decision-making, or action

Applicants are encouraged to propose original research questions and approaches that extend beyond these examples while demonstrating a clear connection to CAMELOT's overarching research agenda.

A range of methodological approaches may be appropriate, including quantitative, qualitative, experimental, and mixed-methods research. The proposed research must be feasible within the period of employment.

The candidate will conduct their own research while working closely with the CAMELOT team. They will benefit from interaction with CAMELOT's theoretical, experimental, and participatory research and may develop complementary or comparative studies building on concepts, methods, interventions, or findings developed within the project.


Qualification requirements

We are looking for candidates who meet the following requirements:

  • master's degree of 120 ECTS or equivalent in political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, sociology, psychology, futures studies, science and technology studies, human geography, or another field relevant to the position
  • grade of B or better on both the master's thesis and the master's degree overall, or an equivalent academic record
  • demonstrate knowledge of research methods relevant to the proposed PhD project
  • strong analytical and academic writing skills
  • excellent written and spoken English

Candidates who are close to completing their master's degree may apply, provided that the degree is completed before the start of the position.

It will be an advantage

It will be considered an advantage to have knowledge of or previous research experience related to one or more of the following areas: climate or environmental governance; public policy; long-term or anticipatory governance; futures and foresight; environmental or political psychology; narratives and communication; Earth system risks and tipping points; or experimental and intervention-based social science.

Experience with empirical data collection and analysis, participation in research projects, academic publishing, or interdisciplinary research will also be considered an advantage.

General criteria for employment as a Research Fellow are stipulated in the Regulations relating to the Universities and University Colleges Act. 

Admission to the doctoral program is a prerequisite. Admission to the doctoral program is based on a comprehensive assessment of the application, including the relevance and quality of the project description. A finalized project plan for the employment period is required completed and acknowledged within 3 months from the date of employment.

See information about admission criteria to the PhD-programme.

It is important for OsloMet to reflect the diverse and multicultural populationof our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavors to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work or have been studying or in training, you are also welcome to apply.


We offer

The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary and international research environment working at the intersection of climate governance, public policy, futures research, and the social sciences.

The position offers:

  • exciting job tasks at Norway’s third largest university
  • opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
  • three-year full-time position with 100% salary; possibility to extend to 4 years with teaching duties
  • beneficial pension arrangements with the Norwegian State Pension Fund 
  • good employee welfare arrangements
  • free Norwegian classes to employees
  • working location in downtown Oslo with multiple cultural offers
  • close integration into the ERC-funded CAMELOT research team and the Public Administration and Governance research environment at Oslo Business School
  • close supervision and intellectual exchange with researchers working on long-term governance, climate governance, experimental social science, futures and anticipation, and science-policy engagement

The position provides an opportunity to develop an independent scholarly profile while being embedded in a larger international research project with strong connections to academic and policy communities.

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMets pay policy for PhD Candidate in code 1017), corresponding to 550 800 NOK per year. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK). (double check salary in the salary plan booklet and pay scales set by OsloMet).

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process 

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.

Please upload the following documents together by the application deadline: 

  • an application letter (maximum two pages) explaining your motivation for applying and how your background, research interests, and experience are relevant to the position 
  • a project proposal (maximum five pages, excluding references), following the requirements above
  • CV
  • certificates and transcripts for bachelor's and master's degrees, including grades; The certificates/diplomas must include ECTS grades (A–F). Foreign diplomas must be translated into English by the degree-conferring institution.
  • a copy of the master's thesis and up to two published academic works
  • names and contact information for two reference persons. Reference letters are not required at the application stage.

We only consider applications submitted through our electronic recruitment system, and all documents must be uploaded for your application to be considered. The documents must be in a Scandinavian language or English. Translations must be authorized, and you will be asked to present originals if you are invited for an interview. OsloMet verifies documents to give candidates a proper evaluation and ensure fair competition. Incomplete applications will not be considered.

For relevant positions, OsloMet conducts background checks of applicants in cooperation with an external provider, in order to verify information contained in available documents. Background checks are always carried out with the candidate’s consent, and employment in these positions is conditional upon an approved background check. Relevant applicants will receive further information about this.


Other information 

If you would like more information about the position, feel free to contact:

  • Head of unit Siri Brorstad Borlaug, (+47) 993 05 003 
  • Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit, (+47) 922 81 887 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

 

OsloMet – Oslo Metropolitan Universityis Norway's third-largest university, with 23,000 students and more than 2,600 employees. We have campuses in central Oslo and the Romerike region. Our research and education address the needs of working life, the welfare state, and the wider metropolitan region.

 

For more than 200 years,OsloMet – Oslo Metropolitan Universityhas contributed to building the knowledge and expertise that underpin the Norwegian welfare state. jobs.title: Training Coordinator
jobs.description:
The Wärtsilä Land & Sea Academy (WLSA) is responsible for delivering high-quality learning services to customers and employees around the world. Our training portfolio supports Wärtsilä's innovative technologies and solutions across the marine and energy sectors, helping customers develop the skills needed for a more sustainable future.


We are now looking for an enthusiastic Training Coordinator to join our Training Coordination team in Vaasa, Finland. Whilst we offer hybrid working, the operational nature of our business often requires attendance on site, and occasional flexibility outside normal working hours may be required.

In this role, you will be at the heart of our global training operations, working closely with customers, instructors, sales teams, and business stakeholders to ensure an outstanding learning experience from initial enquiry to training completion. You will combine customer service, operational coordination, digital tools, and continuous improvement to deliver successful training programmes that create value for our customers and Wärtsilä.


If you enjoy working in an international environment, building strong relationships, and coordinating multiple activities simultaneously, this could be your next career opportunity.



What will you be doing?


As a Training Coordinator, you will manage and coordinate the end-to-end training delivery process while ensuring a seamless customer experience.


Your responsibilities will include:


Training Operations



* Coordinate training delivery activities at the Vaasa Training Centre and other assigned learning environments.
* Manage course scheduling, participant registrations, notifications, reporting, and training documentation.
* Maintain training records and related data in SAP, Learning Management Systems, and other digital platforms.
* Coordinate resources (instructors, classrooms, workshop) allocation.
* Support training delivery and help resolve operational challenges quickly and effectively.
* Monitor customer feedback and identify opportunities to improve services and processes.



Customer and Business Support


* Support the planning, promotion, and execution of training activities for internal and external customers.
* Create and maintain training offerings and service packages.
* Collaborate with sales, account management, contract management, and business stakeholders to promote learning solutions.
* Support internal and external communication activities related to training services.


What will help you succeed?



We are looking for someone who combines strong coordination skills with a passion for customer service and continuous improvement.


You will ideally have:



* A Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Experience with Learning management systems (LMS), training administration, learning operations, customer service, project coordination, or a similar role.
* Experience working with SAP and Salesforce would be considered an advantage.
* Strong digital skills and confidence in learning new systems and technologies.
* Excellent, organisational and multitasking abilities. You will be adept at coordinating evolving requirements and will frequently need to adapt to factors outside your control.
* A structured and detail-oriented way of working.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* A proactive mindset and ability to identify and implement improvements.
* Ability to work under pressure and prioritise tasks effectively. You will be empowered to make decisions within your scope to advance your workload.
* A customer-focused approach and commitment to delivering high-quality service.
* Fluent English skills, both written and spoken.
* Finnish language skills are considered an advantage.


Why join us?


At Wärtsilä Land & Sea Academy, you will become part of a global learning organisation that plays a key role in developing the competencies needed for the future of energy and marine industries. We believe that great results come from empowered people. We encourage ownership, accountability, and collaboration, creating an environment where individuals can contribute, develop, and make a meaningful difference.


As part of our global learning organisation, you will work alongside experienced professionals in a culture built on respect, inclusion, and continuous learning. We value openness, encourage new ideas, and see challenges as opportunities to improve. Everyone is encouraged to bring their authentic self to work and contribute their unique perspective.


We particularly appreciate candidates who demonstrate adaptability, curiosity, and commitment to professional growth. Experience gained across different functions, projects, or disciplines is highly valued, as it helps us build agile teams capable of supporting a diverse and evolving business environment.

jobs.employer: Helsingin Nuorten Miesten Kristillinen Yhdistys ry
jobs.description:
**Etsimme reippaita, luotettavia ja lasten kanssa viihtyviä sijaisia iltapäiväkerhoihimme kaudelle 2026–2027.**

Sijaisena pääset työskentelemään osana iltapäiväkerhon ohjaajatiimiä ja tekemään merkityksellistä työtä lasten parissa. Sijaisuudet voivat olla **yksittäisiä päiviä tai pidempiä sijaisuusjaksoja**, joten työ sopii hyvin esimerkiksi opiskelijalle, osa-aikatyötä etsivälle tai henkilölle, joka haluaa tutustua kasvatusalaan käytännössä.

Työvuorot sijoittuvat pääosin **arkisin kello 11–17 välille**.

**Mitä sijaisen työ iltapäiväkerhossa on?**

Iltapäiväkerhon sijaisena osallistut yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa lasten turvallisen ja mielekkään iltapäivän rakentamiseen.

**Työhösi kuuluu esimerkiksi:**

- lasten vastaanottaminen ja heidän turvallisuudestaan huolehtiminen

- leikkien, pelien, ulkoilun ja muun toiminnan ohjaaminen

- lasten kohtaaminen ja tukeminen erilaisissa arjen tilanteissa

- välipala- ja siirtymätilanteissa avustaminen

- sovittujen sääntöjen ja päivittäisten rutiinien ylläpitäminen

- yhteistyö iltapäiväkerhon muun henkilöstön kanssa


Et jää työssä yksin, vaan työskentelet osana iltapäiväkerhon tiimiä ja saat perehdytyksen työtehtäviisi.

**Toivomme sinulta:**

- aitoa kiinnostusta työskennellä lasten kanssa

- positiivista ja kannustavaa tapaa kohdata lapsia

- luotettavuutta ja vastuullisuutta

- kykyä toimia osana työyhteisöä

- joustavuutta muuttuvissa arjen tilanteissa

- riittävää suomen kielen taitoa lasten ja työyhteisön kanssa toimimiseen


Aikaisempi kokemus lasten tai nuorten kanssa työskentelystä katsotaan eduksi, mutta **kaikissa sijaisuuksissa kasvatusalan koulutus tai pitkä työkokemus ei ole välttämätön**. Tärkeintä on hyvä asenne, vastuullisuus ja halu toimia lasten kanssa.

**Tarjoamme sinulle:**

- mahdollisuuden tehdä merkityksellistä työtä lasten parissa

- perehdytyksen iltapäiväkerhon toimintaan

- kokeneen työyhteisön tuen

- mahdollisuuden saada työkokemusta kasvatusalalta

- vaihtelevan työn, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole täysin samanlainen

- mahdollisuuden tehdä sijaisuuksia oman tilanteesi mukaan


Sijaisena toimiminen on myös hyvä tapa tutustua toimintaamme. Haemme säännöllisesti uusia työntekijöitä pidempiin työsuhteisiin, joten hyvin sujunut sijaisuus voi avata mahdollisuuksia myös myöhempään työskentelyyn kanssamme.

Jos olet vastuullinen, tulet toimeen erilaisten ihmisten kanssa ja haluat olla mukana rakentamassa lapsille **turvallista, iloista ja kannustavaa iltapäivää**, jätä meille hakemuksesi.

Medarbejder til forsendelsen på aftenhold hos SCANGLAS

Vi søger en stabil og ansvarsbevidst medarbejder til vores forsendelse på aftenholdet i vores produktion i Kjellerup. Her får du en vigtig rolle i den sidste del af processen, inden vores ruder og spejle sendes videre til kunderne.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du skal blandt andet:

• Pakke ruder og spejle på vogne og stel

• Båndlægge og foliere de færdige stel

• Køre transportstellene frem til lastbilerne

• Sikre, at leverancerne er pakket korrekt og klar til afgang

Arbejdet er fysisk, og der kan være travlt. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan bevare overblikket og arbejder omhyggeligt – også når tempoet er højt.

Om dig

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

• er stabil og møder til tiden

• er pligtopfyldende og ansvarsbevidst

• kan arbejde selvstændigt og tager fat, hvor der er behov

• arbejder struktureret og har blik for, at tingene bliver gjort korrekt

• bidrager positivt til samarbejdet på holdet

Du skal som minimum kunne kommunikere på engelsk. Det er en fordel, hvis du også taler dansk.

Truckcertifikat er ikke et krav, men det vil være en fordel.

Arbejdstider

Arbejdsstedet er på SCANGLAS’ fabrik i Kjellerup.

Stillingen er på fast aftenhold med følgende arbejdstider:

Mandag til torsdag kl. 14.30–22.05

Fredag kl. 12.00–18.00

Vi tilbyder

Du bliver en del af SCANGLAS og et hold, hvor vi samarbejder om at få kundernes leverancer sikkert og korrekt afsted. Du får en grundig introduktion til arbejdsopgaverne og vores arbejdsgange.

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning til HR@scanglas.dk hurtigst muligt. Vi holder samtaler løbende og afslutter rekrutteringen, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Annette Dalmose på telefon 26 87 50 80.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Pædagogisk assistent til vuggestue
jobs.description:
Børnehytten søger en dedikeret pædagogisk assistent til vores vuggestue.

Hvem er vi: 

Vi er en privat integreret daginstitution beliggende i hjertet af Kettinge. Vi er normeret til 12 vuggestuebørn og 29 børnehavebørn. Vi har tæt samarbejde med forældrebestyrelse og det lokale forenings- og forretningsliv.

Huset rummer nærhed, omsorg og sammenhold for børnene såvel som for kollegaerne. Vi har fokus på trivsel og tryghed og vægter derfor bl.a. forældrekontakten højt. Vi er gode til at arbejde sammen og spille hinanden gode i hverdagen. Grundet husets størrelse er der en naturlig god relation til børnene på tværs af stuerne og vi kan hurtigt træde til på alle stuer, hvis behovet opstår. 

Børnehytten støder op til en tidligere grusgrav, der nu fungerer som rekreativt område med bålhytte, naturlegeplads, kunstige søer med fisk og mange andre muligheder for udfoldelser med børnene. Derudover har vi vores egen legeplads der er opdelt i vuggestue og børnehave, hvor vi prioriterer at børnene kommer ud hver dag. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du nyder at være en del af udelivet uanset vind og vejr, da vores børn også elsker at hoppe i vandpytter, kigge på biller og finde regnorme.

I vuggestuen er værdien af tid central for vores pædagogiske arbejde. Tid til nærvær, tid til fordybelse og tid til at skabe små betydningsfulde øjeblikke der danner fundamentet for børnenes læring, udvikling, trivsel og dannelse. Vi har fokus på at skabe udviklende læringsmiljøer, hvor alle børn – uanset behov og forudsætning -har mulighed for at deltage i meningsfulde fællesskaber.

Vi forventer af dig:

Du er uddannet pædagogisk assistent og gerne med erfaring fra dagtilbudsområdet. Du er empatisk, omsorgsfuld og vægter arbejdet med relationer højt. Du er nysgerrig og legende i din tilgang til børnene og vægter tid, tillid og tryghed højt hos både store og små.

Du skal have en naturlig interesse og nysgerrighed på sproglig udvikling og brugen af det i hverdagen.

Du kan i samarbejde med dine kollegaer på stuen, planlægge aktiviteter og evaluere disse med udgangspunkt i den nye styrkede pædagogiske læreplan.

Du kan samarbejde med din kollegaer, om at vurdere børnenes trivsel og udvikling og ved behov iværksætte konkrete tiltag. Du skal kunne se det enkelte barn og bidrage til at udarbejde handleplaner, indstillinger, koordinere tværfagligt samarbejde med mere.

 

Om stillingen:

Vi tilbyder en ansættelse hurtigst mulig eller fra 1/11-26 i en 32 timers stilling efter gld. overenskomst.

Ansøgningsfrist: 23/9-26 Samtaler forventes afholdt i uge 40.

Send din ansøgning og CV til leder@boernehytten.dk

 

Kontakt gerne leder: Tinni eller souschef Stine - 53841514 - Man-Fredag kl. 9-15, for mere information.

jobs.title: Myyjä kodinturva-alalle
jobs.description:
**Myyjänämme edustat Suomen suosituinta kodinturva-alan hälytysjärjestelmää ja työskentelet Great Place to Work -sertifioidussa organisaatiossa. Mikäli tämä kuulostaa sinulle sopivalta työpaikalta, jatka lukemista alta!**

**Huomioithan, että tämä ei ole kesätyötehtävä. Etsimme myyjiä, jotka haluavat työskennellä meillä kokoaikaisesti myös kesän jälkeen.**

**Miltä arkesi näyttää meillä?**

Myyjänämme liikut Verisuren tarjoamalla käyttöetuautolla ja toimit hälytysjärjestelmäpalvelumme asiantuntijana. Työsi keskiössä on asiakkaan tiloissa tehtävä turvakartoitus, jossa arvioit kohteen turvallisuustarpeet ja suunnittelet siihen parhaan ratkaisun. Tavoitteenasi on rakentaa asiakkaalle räätälöity turvasuojaus ja varmistaa hänen kotinsa tai yritystilojensa turvallisuus.

Viikkokalenterisi koostuu valmiiksi sovituista turvakartoituksista sekä itse hankkimistasi asiakaskäynneistä, koulutuksia ja tiimipalavereja unohtamatta. Kun turvakartoitukset alkavat onnistua ja tuottamaan kauppoja, koulutamme sinut asentamaan kaupatut hälytysjärjestelmät asiakkaidesi kohteisiin. Pääset parhaimmillaan tarjoamaan asiakkaallesi kokonaisvaltaisen palvelukokemuksen ensikohtaamisesta tapaamiseen, ja lopulta järjestelmän asentamiseen. Työpäiväsi ovat liikkuvia ja vaihtelevia, ja työtä tehdään arkipäivisin lähtökohtaisesti klo 12:00–20:00. Perehdytyksen jälkeen aikataulut muuttuvat joustavammiksi ja pääset itse vaikuttamaan siihen, miten järjestät asiakaskäyntisi.

**Kelle tämä työ sopii?**

Mikäli koet syttyväsi tavoitteiden saavuttamisesta ja konkreettisista onnistumisista, löytyy sinulta hyvät eväät työssä menestymiseen. Myös tietty pilke silmäkulmassa kilpailullisuuden suhteen antaa hyvää lisäpotkua tekemiseen. Arvostamme aiempaa kokemusta suoramyynnin tai turvallisuusalan parista, mutta voit olla myös esimerkiksi tavoitteellista myyntityötä etsivä alanvaihtaja, joka etsii uusia haasteita uralleen. Kurkkaa urasivuiltamme www.verisure.fi/ura, millaista arki Verisuren myyjänä voi olla.

**Mitä edellytämme:**

- B-luokan ajokortti (manuaali) ja valmius liikkua työtehtävissä Verisuren käyttöetuautolla.

- Sujuvat yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot suomen kielellä, kyky kohdata asiakkaat ammattimaisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti.
