- Identifier les possibilités de réduction du gaspillage et de valorisation des surplus.
- Étudier les regroupements de commandes ou de contrats avec les établissements partenaires.

- Veiller à la qualité de l'accueil et à la cohérence de l'expérience client sur l'ensemble du parcours.
Qualité, maintenance, sécurité et gestion des déchets
- Mettre en place une méthode efficace d'identification et de suivi des pannes ou détériorations dans les chambres.
- Déclencher et suivre les réparations nécessaires avec les interlocuteurs concernés.
- Réaliser des contrôles qualité aléatoires de 5 à 10 chambres par semaine.
- Contribuer à la coordination avec le référent sécurité de l'immeuble et aux échanges avec les autorités compétentes.

Développement commercial et optimisation du chiffre d'affaires
- Mener des actions de prospection auprès des entreprises locales et des organisateurs d'événements.
- Assurer une veille concurrentielle et contribuer à l'optimisation des tarifs hôteliers.
- Mettre en œuvre les principes de base du yield management avec l'appui des outils de réservation et de facturation existants.
Reporting et relation avec la direction
- Participer à une réunion mensuelle avec la présidente.
- Signaler sans délai tout dysfonctionnement important concernant le personnel, les clients, la sécurité ou les investissements à prévoir.
- Scanner et transmettre les factures papier, ainsi que les états mensuels nécessaires aux déclarations de TVA et de taxe de séjour.
Le profil recherché
- Expérience confirmée dans la direction ou la gestion d'un hôtel, d'un établissement d'hébergement ou d'une activité HCR.
- Solides compétences en management, organisation des plannings et accompagnement des équipes.
- Maîtrise des outils de réservation et de facturation ; une première expérience en yield management est appréciée.
- Rigueur administrative, sens du suivi budgétaire et capacité à travailler avec des partenaires comptables.
- Très bon relationnel, sens du service client, autonomie et capacité à prendre des décisions pragmatiques.
- Goût du terrain, esprit d'initiative et capacité à évoluer dans un cadre de collaboration souple et proche de la direction.
Ce que nous proposons
- Un poste central dans un établissement à taille humaine et à forte identité locale.
- Une réelle autonomie dans la structuration de l'exploitation et l'amélioration des méthodes

jobs.title: Doctoral Researcher: MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC 06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries
jobs.description:
[Se nedan för svenska]

MSCA Doctoral Network EMANAIRE, DC06: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries

Position details

Recruiting institution: Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation

Work location: Helsinki, Finland · one position

Contract: four-year, full-time doctoral scholarship · 48 months

Expected start: 1 February 2027 or by agreement

Application deadline: by 11:59 p.m. on 29 October 2026

Doctoral programme: PhD in Management and Organisation

Apply: https://hanken.rekrytointi.com/paikat/index.php?o=A_LOJ&list=1&lang=en&rspvt=bx32qk756igw8ww08c0k4sgg0w8w48c

Hanken School of Economics, Department of Management and Organisation invites applications for this four-year doctoral scholarship in the EMANAIRE project, PhD project: AI Co-Creation, Morality, and the Inner Good in Creative Industries.

About EMANAIRE

EMANAIRE is a Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions Doctoral Network bringing together 15 doctoral candidates at nine European universities to study how AI is changing work. Its projects examine what happens when generative and agentic AI enters leadership, everyday workflows, team communication, professional learning and career decisions. Across the network, human agency means the practical ability to understand AI-supported decisions, exercise judgement, question outputs and shape how work is organised. Each researcher joins an international cohort, receives supervision across institutions and takes part in three residential schools, methods workshops, monthly research seminars and joint work with organisations beyond academia. Every project includes extensive engagement with industrial partner (e.g. in terms of data collection and development of practice).

The doctoral project

What happens to the value and purpose of creative work when people create alongside AI? This project studies how AI agents, AI-mediated processes and platform algorithms reshape co-creation and moral questions in creative industries. It follows employees, freelancers and studios as they negotiate changes to their work and business models. Through ethnographic fieldwork you will research what practitioners value within the activity of making creative work, and how that changes across human, hybrid and automated practices. The project aims to develop a practice-based account of co-creation and offer guidance for organisations and policymakers seeking equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.

Your work

- Study how AI agents and platform algorithms reshape co-creation, moral questions and business models in creative industries.
- Conduct ethnographic fieldwork with employees, freelancers and studios.
- Examine what practitioners value in creative work across human, hybrid and automated practices.
- Develop a practice-based account and guidance for equitable, responsible and sustainable creative work.
- Refine the research questions and design with the supervision team and prepare ethics, data-management and open-science materials.
- Complete a doctoral thesis and related research outputs under the host doctoral programme and EMANAIRE plan.
- Take part in local and network-wide training, cohort activities, reviews, dissemination and practitioner engagement.
- Participate in teaching related activities at the Department of Management and Organisation.
- Undertake collaboration with the industry partner and a separate academic mobility visit.
- Contribute to research integrity, equality, responsible AI, open science and FAIR data practices.

Supervision, training and mobility

Project contact: Mikko Vesa (mikko.vesa@hanken.fi).

Main supervisor: Professor Mikko Vesa (Hanken School of Economics).

Current DoA plan: The Doctoral researcher is expected to spend a period of time at an industrial partner conducting the ethnographic research and contributing to practice.

Academic mobility visit: At least three months at another partner institution of the EMANAIRE network.

The researcher will complete at least 60 ECTS of doctoral coursework, including at least 10 ECTS through network-wide provision. EMANAIRE combines local doctoral courses with three residential schools, monthly paper-development seminars, work-package workshops and network reviews. A Personal Career Development Plan will be agreed within the first three months and reviewed every six months.

About Hanken School of Economics

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Hanken Masters in Management programme was ranked #56 by the Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

Hanken is part of the European ENGAGE.EU European university alliance, that collaborates in the area of doctoral education by creating common practices and offering courses across member universities. The Department of Management and Organisation is recognized for its outstanding research in areas such as organisation studies, human resource management, business ethics and strategic entrepreneurship. The doctoral programme at Hanken is designed as a four-year full-time education, consisting of coursework, thesis work and teaching. Hanken provides comprehensive support throughout the doctoral journey, including supervision, study administration, performance monitoring, and assistance with funding. There is also support for applying for postdoctoral research funding.

Who we are looking for

Applicants should hold, or be close to completing by the start date, a relevant master's degree or equivalent and demonstrate the potential to undertake independent doctoral research. Research, policy or industry experience relevant to the project is advantageous.

In order to be accepted as a Doctoral Researcher at Hanken, applicants must fulfill the formal admission requirements for PhD studies#_msocom_1: https://www.hanken.fi/en/apply/application/phd-programme/attachments . A Masters

jobs.title: Technicien / Technicienne de hot line en informatique
jobs.description:
Enreach for Service Providers développe la plateforme UCaaS sur laquelle les opérateurs télécoms à travers l'Europe font fonctionner leurs communications professionnelles. Nous sommes environ 60 personnes basées à Sophia-Antipolis, membres du groupe Enreach. Notre logiciel est utilisé par des centaines de milliers d'utilisateurs de téléphonie professionnelle. Ici, le support n'est pas une simple fonction de déviation d'appels. C'est le point de contact où la plateforme rencontre la réalité du terrain.

Vos missions :
Être en première ligne : répondre à la hotline de support, qualifier les tickets Jira entrants et effectuer le premier diagnostic réel de chaque problème avant qu'il ne soit transmis ailleurs. C'est vous qui décidez de l'urgence.
Accompagner nos partenaires EUPCloud : nos partenaires SaaS ne disposent pas de leurs propres équipes opérationnelles. Ils comptent sur nous. Vous travaillerez directement avec eux - via Jira, les canaux Teams, le téléphone - pour les guider dans la configuration et les aider à comprendre leur propre plateforme. Cette partie du rôle est nouvelle, et c'est la raison pour laquelle nous recrutons.
Savoir gérer efficacement :  lorsqu'un problème dépasse le niveau L1, vous le documentez correctement et assurez le suivi jusqu'à sa résolution. Ici, on ne se contente pas de traiter des tickets à moitié diagnostiqués.
Documenter les procédures : tout problème que vous résolvez deux fois aurait dû être documenté une fois. Notre base de connaissances est le levier qui permet à l'équipe de gagner en rapidité.
Monter en expertise avec le temps : vous commencerez par le triage. En l'espace d'un an, vous connaîtrez notre plateforme mieux que la plupart de ceux qui l'ont construite, car vous aurez vu toutes les façons dont elle peut tomber en panne.

Votre profil :

Maîtrise du français et aisance en anglais : vous travaillerez en français au quotidien. Cependant, nos partenaires étant répartis dans toute l'Europe, vous devrez également répondre à des appels de la hotline et rédiger des mises à jour de tickets en anglais. Votre anglais n'a pas besoin d'être parfait ou sans accent. Il doit être suffisamment bon pour qu'un ingénieur stressé à Rotterdam se sente pris en charge.
Quelqu'un qui aime le téléphone : pas quelqu'un qui le "tolère", mais qui l'aime. Guider calmement un ingénieur stressé à travers un problème, un vendredi à 16h, est une véritable compétence et est au cœur de ce métier.
Curiosité pour le fonctionnement des systèmes : vous avez cassé quelque chose, vous avez compris pourquoi, et vous l'avez réparé. Linux et Unix, le réseau, et idéalement une première approche de SIP ou VoIP - même s'il s'agit simplement d'un serveur Asterisk maison et de beaucoup de Wireshark.
Autonome : on vous donnera un problème, pas un script. Il s'agit d'une petite équipe de personnes expérimentées qui agissent vite et n'attendent pas qu'on leur dise quoi faire.
Quelqu'un qui tire les autres vers le haut : nous déboguons ensemble, nous nous enseignons mutuellement, et personne ici ne garde ses connaissances pour soi. Si cela vous semble évident, nous nous entendrons bien.

Les petits plus (atouts) :
Maîtrise de Linux (famille Rocky / RHEL) au-delà des bases.
Connaissance de SIP, RTP, et les joies spécifiques du débogage d'un problème d'audio unidirectionnel.
Capacité à scripter dans n'importe quel langage.
Allemand, néerlandais ou espagnol : ces langues sont un plus, mais aucune n'est obligatoire.

Jusqu'à 2 jours de télétravail par semaine, une fois que vous aurez été pleinement intégré et que vous travaillerez en autonomie.

jobs.description:
Autoriseret kloakmester – 4-dages uge, stor frihed og mulighed for medejer

Vil du have mere frihed, færre arbejdsdage og en reel mulighed for at få indflydelse og ejerskab?
Så er det her ikke bare et job – det er en mulighed.

Vi søger en autoriseret kloakmester til en spændende og alsidig stilling i en mindre, veldrevet virksomhed med base i Thy.
Du kan bo hvor som helst i Danmark – det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at tage ansvar og arbejde en del på Sjælland i en 4-dages arbejdsuge.

Det får du

-4-dages arbejdsuge (mandag–torsdag)
 -Stor frihed til selv at planlægge din hverdag
 -Firmabil og alt nødvendigt udstyr
 -Varierede opgaver – ingen ensformige dage
 -Kort vej fra idé til handling
 -Mulighed for medejer/partnerskab på sigt

Hverdagen

Du får en alsidig hverdag med både store og små opgaver – fra nyanlæg, renovering og dræn til fejlfinding, dokumentation og kvalitetssikring.

Du bliver en nøgleperson i virksomheden med tæt kundekontakt, samarbejde med entreprenører og direkte indflydelse på, hvordan opgaver løses, og hvordan forretningen udvikler sig.

Vi leder efter dig, der

• Er autoriseret kloakmester
• Bor et sted i Danmark og er fleksibel ift. opgaver på Sjælland
• Trives med ansvar og selvstændigt arbejde
• Har styr på kvalitet, dokumentation og struktur
• Har ambitioner og lyst til at være med på den lange bane
• Er typen, der ser muligheder – ikke begrænsninger

Om virksomheden

Virksomheden er en mindre, seriøs og ambitiøs aktør med fokus på kvalitet, ordentlighed og langvarige kunderelationer. Der er styr på tingene – og samtidig plads til nye idéer og udvikling.

For den rette kandidat er der en realistisk mulighed for medejer/partnerskab, hvis kemien og ambitionerne matcher.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning og CV til dg@kvr.dk
Har du spørgsmål, så ring til Dan Gyldenberg på 25 38 84 06

Vi holder samtaler løbende – og venter gerne på den rette.

Om jobbet

Arbejdsopgaverne består primært af:

  • Byggemodninger

  • Kloakarbejder

  • Etablering af veje og stier

  • Anlægsarbejder for offentlige og private bygherrer

  • Udgravning, planering og øvrige maskinopgaver inden for anlægsbranchen

Du bliver en del af et fast og velfungerende sjak, hvor vi lægger vægt på ordentlighed, samarbejde og høj faglig kvalitet.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring som maskinfører inden for anlægsbranchen

  • Passer godt på dit materiel og holder maskinen i pæn og præsentabel stand

  • Er kvalitetsbevidst og ønsker at levere et godt stykke arbejde hver dag

  • Fast arbejde i en virksomhed med en stærk ordrebog

  • Moderne materiel og gode arbejdsforhold

Vores projekter sprder sig fra vores base i vejle, til henover fyn, samt det meste af sjælland, og det forventes at være tilfældet de kommende år.

Du vil indgå i et fast sjak, som ligger ude mandag til torsdag på Sjælland. Bor du selv på Sjælland, skal du derfor forvente en arbejdsuge på 4 dage.

Om 3TF ANLÆG A/S

3TF ANLÆG A/S udfører jord-, kloak-, belægnings- og anlægsarbejder for både offentlige og private kunder. Vi vægter kvalitet, ordentlighed og godt samarbejde højt, og vi investerer løbende i både medarbejdere og materiel.

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in AI-Assisted Software and Systems Engineering
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia. 

The Software Engineering group conducts research in a wide range of topics related to design, development, verification, and operation of complex software systems, including emerging technologies and their relation to Software Engineering. You will join a diverse research environment and an exciting Doctoral Programme.

Your immediate leader will be the Leader of the Software Engineering unit.


About the project

Software is today prominent in many critical systems and infrastructures, such as power distribution systems, railway infrastructure, or flight control systems. These systems are subject to complex development and verification processes, including certification and audits, and in general different activities that span the Software Engineering and the Systems Engineering disciplines.

Generative AI and AI agents are rapidly changing how software-based systems are being designed, developed, and evaluated. While AI agents have become common in certain Software Engineering tasks, such as programming, documentation, and vulnerability detection, their adoption for other tasks such as software architecture design, or safety and hazard analysis, is still limited. 

The objective of this position is to investigate and evaluate solutions for software engineering and systems engineering tasks in critical systems and infrastructures. Within this context, the project can be tailored to the interests and background of the successful candidate.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Author academic publications and popular science dissemination material
  • Participate in the Software Engineering research group
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Support to education activities in courses within the Software Engineering area
  • Other career-promoting work, such as learning grant preparation fundamentals

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the Doctoral Programme in Computer Science, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and no later than 30.10.2026.
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • Good programming skills.
  • Good oral and written presentation skills in English.
     

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria

The following characteristics will be considered an advantage during the selection process:

  • Good understanding of Software Engineering or Systems Engineering fundamentals
  • Experience with modeling of software and/or system architecture
  • Experience with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Microsoft Agent Framework)
  • Good knowledge of AI concepts, particularly Generative AI
  • Knowledge of aspects related to critical systems and infrastructures

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Be good at anticipating problems and identifying logical solutions as well as contradictions and inconsistencies  
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
     

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer

.

  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work in addition to 1 year of career promotion work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Computer Science within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees.
  • CV.
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing your own research proposal within the topics of this position, including a description of research questions, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages).
  • Short motivation letter (cover letter) (maximum 400 words/1 page).
  • Scientific publications if you have, or other relevant work that fits the position topics.
  • Names and contact information of three references.
     

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Leonardo Montecchi, +47 734 12 964, leonardo.montecchi@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact our HR hiring team at HR@IDI.ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 08.10.2026

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage. 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. "    vypracovává rozbory, metodiky provozních činností, vztahující se k zajištění stability dendrologického potenciálu města Plzně,
"    projednávat a schvalovat požadavky jiných subjektů na zásahy do dřevin,

Kvalifikační a odborné požadavky:

"    vzdělání - preferujeme VŠ obor zahradnictví, arboristika, krajinářská architektura, správa zeleně, zahradní a krajinářské realizace, lesnictví, zemědělství případně SŠ obdobného zaměření s praxí v oboru
"    řidičský průkaz skupiny B,
"    znalost práce na PC (MS office).

Nabízíme:
"    zajímavá, koncepční práce a perspektivní zaměstnání,
"    motivující osobní příplatek, mimořádné odměny a další zaměstnanecké výhody (příspěvek na penzijní připojištění, stravenkový paušál, 5 dní indispozičního volna, výhodnější paušály na volání, 5 týdnů dovolené).
Doklady potřebné pro přihlášení do výběrového řízení:
1.    strukturovaný životopis,
2.    podepsané prohlášení uchazeče v následujícím znění: Poskytnutím svých osobních údajů v rozsahu podkladů pro přihlášku do výběrového řízení dávám souhlas k jejich zpracování (jméno, příjmení, titul, datum narození, podpis).

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager
jobs.description:
DomainTools is looking for a Principal Product Manager to join its Product team. Data is the backbone of our products, and this role will be responsible for growing and refining the data products that drive our threat intelligence solutions, with API-first delivery and integration into UI, AI and third-party experiences and workflows. This is a strategic role for the company that has a high impact on the companyâs success, and has a great deal of visibility both inside and outside the company. The ideal candidate is a strong leader and successful product manager with a track record of delivering market-leading data products, with insights derived from direct customer interaction and big-data analysis. If you want to make a big impact in an established, growth-stage company, and if you love data product management, DomainTools is the place to be!

The product manager is expected to contribute to her/his team a solid knowledge of the various constraints of the business, and a prioritized assessment of the opportunities that the business can capitalize on. The product manager must also contribute to the product team a deep knowledge of our users and customers, and an understanding of the platforms that our customers use to engage with our products. Finally the product manager is expected to track industry trends and the competitive landscape as they pertain to their products.Â 

While each member of the product team may be accountable for a specific area, we look for product managers that understand that consistent innovation is the result of each member of the product team contributing their passion and their ideas.Â  The product manager must collaborate closely with engineering, marketing, sales and solutions engineering teams to deliver world-class solutions to market.

This job, as with the other roles on the product team, is an individual contributor role. You will need to be able to influence your teammates, colleagues, stakeholders, and key executives, through your use of data and logic.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum 7 years in cybersecurity or data-related product management, delivering data-driven analytics and products
  • Deep knowledge of their business and its customers, understanding how data products are utilized by its users, and valued by buyers
  • Experience working with threat intelligence products, threat feeds, APIs, and related technologies
  • Experience interacting with customers who leverage data warehousing, data science, and Big Data technologies
  • Experience with integration of data products into third-party environments (both customer and partner ecosystems)
  • Experience working with Agile (kanban/scrum) development teams and processes
  • Excellent people skills, working with cross-functional teams across the organization to bring a solution from ideation to market
  • Excellent writing, communication, and presentation skills
  • US-based, with a willingness to accommodate core hours that overlap at least 9am-3pm US Pacific time

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in cybersecurity investigations, threat defense, incident response, or related activities
  • Solid understanding of the cybersecurity market and modern security architectures
  • Familiarity with specific data domains used in cybersecurity, including DNS, IP, TLS/SSL certificates, web crawl, BGP, NetFlow data
  • Experience with real-time data collection, processing and delivery
  • Experience with large language models (LLMs) and agentic workflows
  • Experience with data products that leverage predictive analytics / machine learning (ML)
  • Experience with distributed systems and cloud computing

Nous recherchons un Ingénieur Applications pour assurer l'interface technique principale entre les clients, les partenaires système et les équipes d'ingénierie Vsora. Ce rôle combine accompagnement client, support technique, intégration de plateformes et résolution de problèmes au niveau système, afin d'assurer le succès du déploiement des solutions IA basées sur l'accélérateur Vsora.

jobs.title: supervisore dei cantieri edili
jobs.description: Per conto di LPM Prefabbricati (https://www.lpmpref.it/) storica azienda con presenza consolidata sul mercato italiano nella fabbricazione di prefabbricati di grandi dimensioni, ricerchiamo un* Geometra con circa 10 anni di esperienza per un ruolo di Responsabile di Commessa con forte presenza in cantiere. La figura seguirà la commessa e il cantiere quotidianamente: pianificazione montaggi, coordinamento risorse, relazione con il cliente e controllo di tempi/costi, garantendo l'esecuzione efficace dei lavori. Obiettivo del ruolo e responsabilità principali: Assicurare che ogni commessa venga gestita con rispetto di tempi, contratti e consegne, mantenendo un presidio operativo sul cantiere e guidando squadre e fornitori con metodo, disciplina e orientamento al risultato. In particolare: Pianificazione delle commesse: organizzare il susseguirsi dei cantieri sul lungo periodo, in base alle scadenze contrattuali, durata dei cantieri, ecc. Pianificazione montaggi prefabbricati: programmare le attività dall'avvio del cantiere al termine del montaggio. Programmare gli step operativi giornalieri/settimanali, e seguire l'avanzamento dei lavori. Coordinamento squadre di cantiere e subappaltatori: organizzazione, controllo operatività, gestione comportamenti e standard (es. riduzione inefficienze). Interfaccia con clienti: gestione richieste e criticità con approccio pratico (es. rimodulare l'ordine di montaggio per rispettare esigenze del cliente senza perdere controllo su tempi/costi). Controllo tempi / contratti / spedizioni: presidio consegne, vincoli contrattuali, varianti ed extra. Valutazione e controllo costi: stime, consuntivi, supporto alla marginalità e gestione economica della commessa. Topografia e rilievi di cantiere: tracciamenti, verifiche quote/dimensioni e controllo esecutivo (in coordinamento con ufficio tecnico/DL dove previsto). Collaborazione continua con ufficio tecnico, produzione e logistica per garantire continuità tra prefabbricazione e montaggio. Requisiti: Diploma di Geometra (o titolo tecnico equivalente). ~10 anni di esperienza in cantieri industriali con responsabilità di capocantiere, o responsabile operativo, o responsabile commessa. Preferibile esperienza in prefabbricati o provenienza da imprese di costruzioni Competenze di pianificazione, gestione priorità, avanzamento lavori e controllo economico. Disponibilità a trasferte su Nord-Ovest Italia e occasionalmente Sud Francia. Leadership concreta e capacità di gestione del team, capacità di far rispettare regole, sicurezza e metodi di lavoro. Ottima relazione con clienti e stakeholder: comunicazione chiara, negoziazione, problem solving. Approccio pratico, orientato a risultato e affidabilità su tempi/consegne. Azienda: LPM Srl Area: Mondovì (CN) e dintorni - raggio 40-45 km Cantieri: Nord-Ovest Italia + occasionali trasferte Sud Francia Contratto: Tempo indeterminato - Full time RAL indicativa: 40.000-50.000 € (commisurata all'esperienza) Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. jobs.title: Procurement Lead Buyer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg:

Join a team of diverse and dedicated problem solvers, connected by a common cause: to turn insight into opportunity for clients and communities around the world. If you are eager to learn, are interested in growing rapidly and strive to make an impact in a diverse environment, you're in the right place at the right time.
Learn more about Careers at KPMG Luxembourg


We are looking for a Lead Buyer (m/f/d) for our Procurement team

As a Lead Buyer reporting to the Procurement Manager, you will play a key role in supporting and developing the procurement function at KPMG Luxembourg. You will be responsible for managing end-to-end sourcing and purchasing activities across your assigned procurement categories while working closely with internal stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver value through strategic procurement initiatives.

In this role, you will contribute to the development of purchasing strategies, supplier optimization initiatives and cost-saving opportunities. You will also ensure compliance with procurement policies, maintain strong supplier relationships and support the continuous evolution of the procurement function.


What you will be working on:

Propose and develop purchasing strategies for assigned procurement categories.
Analyze spend allocation, supplier portfolios and procurement opportunities.
Develop short-, medium- and long-term action plans including spend optimization, contract renewal strategies, supplier rationalization and risk mitigation initiatives.
Participate in defining savings targets and identifying opportunities for improvement.
Identify, evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost and reliability.
Lead sourcing activities including RFPs, RFQs and supplier negotiations.
Manage purchase orders and monitor delivery performance.
Build and maintain strong supplier relationships and monitor supplier performance.
Ensure compliance with procurement policies, internal controls and regulatory requirements.
Prepare procurement reports and contribute to cost control initiatives.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders and provide guidance regarding procurement processes and procedures.


What we look for:

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Logistics or a related field.
Several years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, purchasing or supply chain management.
Experience in supplier sourcing, contract negotiation and supplier relationship management.
Good understanding of procurement processes, sourcing methodologies and procurement best practices.
Ability to identify cost-saving opportunities and drive procurement efficiencies.
Experience working with procurement systems and ERP tools (SAP, Oracle, Coupa or similar).
Strong analytical and reporting skills, including advanced Excel capabilities.
Excellent stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills.
Ability to build collaborative relationships and influence outcomes across the organization.
Fluent English is required; French is considered an asset.


What you will get:

We offer more than just a job. With our flexible work model, you can work, rest and recharge. Our competitive compensation packages, paid time off, recognition bonuses and dedicated programs for personal development and well-being help to keep you refreshed and motivated.

We will accompany you on a journey of professional growth, offering an expansive spectrum of prospects to elevate your career in Luxembourg, an emerging financial center. Feel a sense of belonging by enjoying year-round celebrations and engaging events that bring us all together.


Join our next generation:

Apply now to start your recruitment journey at KPMG Luxembourg!

jobs.title: Senior Finance Business Partner (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a Finance Business Partner (Business Services) based in Luxembourg (hybrid). You will partner with Business Services leadership to drive lean accounting, process optimization and AI-driven reporting, lead budgeting and forecasting cycles, and deliver actionable financial insights that improve performance. The role suits a senior, pragmatic finance professional (10+ years) with SAP and BI experience, a strong process orientation, and a proven ability to deliver under pressure.

As Senior Finance Business Partner (Business Services) you will be the finance lead embedded with Business Services, acting as a change agent to drive lean accounting, process optimization and data-driven decision making. You will tightly partner with COO (Head of Business Services) and the business services leaders to translate operational needs into actionable financial insights, streamline processes through automation and AI-enabled tools, and support performance improvement across cost, quality and delivery. This replacement role requires a senior, hands-on professional who thrives under pressure, prioritizes effectively, and contributes as a collaborative team player.

What you will be working on

• Act as the trusted finance partner to CFO, Head of Finance, COO and Business Services leadership: deliver financial insight, challenge assumptions and influence decisions.
• Act as a sparring partner to the Director of FP&A contributing to robust discussions on financial performance, forecasting assumptions, business plans, controlling model and strategic priorities.
• Lead process improvement and lean accounting initiatives to simplify workflows, reduce waste and strengthen internal controls.
• Design, develop and maintain reporting and analysis that support operational decisions — move towards near real-time, KPI-driven dashboards.
• Drive automation and AI adoption across finance processes (reporting, forecasting, reconciliations, controls), identifying opportunities for AI.
• Support monthly close activities and ensure accuracy and timeliness of financial data.
• Lead budgeting, forecasting and budgetary control processes for Business Services; provide scenario analysis and actionable recommendations.
• Translate business change needs into finance requirements and support implementation of new tools, systems or processes (working closely with Digital Accelerator team  and Finance peers).
• Deliver ad hoc financial analysis and sponsor small-to-medium projects that enhance financial performance or operating model.
• Promote financial and business awareness across the Business function and within Finance through coaching and clear communication.

What we look for

• Strong accounting and controlling background with a minimum of 10 years' relevant experience.
• Advanced Excel; experience with SAP finance modules and Reporting tools.
• Hands-on familiarity with automation/AI tools or demonstrable appetite and experience driving such initiatives.
• Solid budgeting, forecasting and financial modelling skills.
• Excellent communication and presentation skills in English; other languages an asset.
• Proven track record in a finance business partnering role supporting shared services, central functions or similar.
• Demonstrable experience running process improvement projects and delivering automation/AI-driven efficiencies.
• Comfortable operating independently, handling ambiguous situations and escalating appropriately.
• Behavioral skills and competencies: growth mindset, change agent, process-oriented, detail focused, pressure management, team work, decision quality and uphold KPMG firm standars.
• Professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CPA, CFA or equivalent) and experience in professional services or the Big Four environment as an asset.

jobs.title: Directeur amélioration continue (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:

Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0

• Zone Industrielle P.E.D, BP 38, Rodange, Luxembourg, Luxembourg Employees work in a hybrid mode
• Full-time
• Compensation: EUR 116,340 - EUR 186,144 - yearly

Job Description

Are you ready to architect the future of Advanced Manufacturing?
At the Materials Group (MG), we are not just optimizing operations, we are redefining them. We are seeking a visionary and dynamic Director, Continuous Improvement and Industry 4.0  to lead our central Enterprise Lean System (ELS) function.
This is a high-impact, regional executive role designed for an operational architect who can bridge the gap between world-class, foundational Lean Six Sigma methodologies and cutting-edge Industry 4.0 technologies (AI, Predictive Analytics, and Cognitive Automation). Based in our Rodange facility, you will hold the keys to regional standardization, capability building, and digital supply chain transformation across Europe.

The Challenge & The Vision

As the Director of Central ELS, you will play two pivotal roles: the Guardian of Standards and the Pioneer of Innovation.
You will lead a high-performing central team to drive continuous improvement, establishing a high-margin production environment. Concurrently, you will orchestrate the transition from manual Lean frameworks to an AI-driven "Lighthouse Factory" footprint, leveraging predictive models, virtual environments, and connected systems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Guardian of Operational & Supply Chain Standards

• Act as the regional "Center as Guardian," serving as the sole architect of operational standards in the Regional Playbook.
• Govern all core manufacturing work standards (5S, Standard Work Audits, Daily Tier Meetings, Kaizen, SMED, TPM, and OEE Tracking/Loss Analysis).
• Establish robust supply chain standards, covering Production Planning Logic, Inventory Buffer Protocols, Freight Spend Governance, and S&OP Integration.
• Govern and standardize Data Science & AI models across the region.

2. Capability Builder & Training Academy Leader

• Standardize regional workforce mindsets and skillsets through a centralized regional training engine.
• Maintain the end-to-end certification pathway for Yellow, Green, and Black Belt mastery, alongside modern Digital Literacy pathways.
• Design functionally deep training curricula and scale execution through "Train-the-Trainer" initiatives with local site leaders.

3. Orchestrator of Strategy Deployment

• Lead the Yearly Strategic Deployment process ensuring 100% functional alignment between Sales, Marketing, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and IT.
• Utilize the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and key performance metrics to establish regional breakthrough targets.
• Facilitate the collaborative "Catchball" process to negotiate and lock departmental action plans.
• Manage the monthly governance framework for PDCA reviews at executive and functional levels.

4. Pioneer of ELS 4.0 & Digital Twin Innovation

• Drive the shift to automated, AI-driven operations, implementing predictive models that empower local sites to preempt issues.
• Lead shopfloor IoT integration, ensuring machines feed real-time performance data directly into core IT systems.
• Deploy a Regional Control Tower live-dashboard to visualize the entire end-to-end supply chain.
• Deploy advanced solutions for AI-Driven Predictive Quality, Maintenance, Cognitive Automation, and dynamic 3D Digital Twin simulations.

5. Champion of the Hub & Spoke Model

• Serve as the central regional filter and amplifier for operational innovation.
• Capture best-in-class local site innovations directly from the Gemba, codifying validated successes into the "Gold Standard" regional playbook for network-wide deployment.

6. High-Performing Team Leader

• Cultivate an inspiring team culture rooted in high performance, psychological safety, and radical accountability.
• Mentor and coach a dedicated central team, providing clear career development pathways and fostering cross-functional collaboration.

Qualifications

Who You Are

• The Expert: You possess extensive experience leading Lean, Six Sigma, and Continuous Improvement functions on a regional or global scale.
• The Digital Native: You have a proven track record of implementing Industry 4.0 solutions (IoT, Predictive Maintenance, AI, or Digital Twins) within a manufacturing environment.
• The Architect: You excel at designing, documenting, and scaling operational systems and standards from scratch.
• The Communicator: You are an expert at navigating Hoshin Kanri / Strategic Deployment, bringing diverse stakeholders (from the shopfloor to the C-suite) along on the transformation journey.
• The People Developer: You love building capability, leading academies, and mentoring future operational leaders.

• Location: We welcome candidates residing near any of our major manufacturing hubs in Luxembourg, France, the UK, Germany, or Belgium.

Additional Information

Why join Avery Dennison:  We are a global materials science and digital identification solutions company with locations in over 50 countries, and approximately 35,000 employees worldwide. Join our team as an AIFM Risk & Valuation Manager, where you'll play a key role in managing risk and valuations for alternative investment funds like private equity, real estate, and infrastructure. You'll work with advanced risk models, prepare reports for senior stakeholders, and support clients in setting up funds. Consultant(e) – Manager Risk & Finance (H/F)

Qui sommes-nous ?

Finegan Luxembourg fait partie du groupe Finegan, un cabinet de conseil français indépendant fondé en 2009. Notre mission est d'accompagner nos clients dans leurs transformations en favorisant innovation, proximité et engagement à long terme.
Nous valorisons le travail collectif et soutenons nos consultants dans leur développement professionnel tout en respectant nos engagements sociétaux.

Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) Manager Risk & Finance disposant d'une solide expertise en gestion des risques et en finance, ainsi que d'une forte appétence pour le développement commercial et le management d'équipes.

Vos missions principales :

En tant que Manager, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de nos activités et l'accompagnement de nos clients du secteur financier.
À ce titre, vous serez amené(e) à :

Profil recherché :

• Diplôme de niveau Master en Finance, Statistiques, Mathématiques appliquées, Économie ou domaine équivalent.
• Expérience confirmée en gestion des risques et finance acquise au sein d'un cabinet de conseil, d'une banque, d'une compagnie d'assurance ou d'un gestionnaire d'actifs.
• Expérience significative dans la conduite de projets et l'accompagnement de transformations réglementaires.
• Solide expérience en management d'équipe et en encadrement de consultants.
• Forte sensibilité commerciale et goût pour le développement de relations clients durables.
• Excellente compréhension des enjeux actuels du secteur financier luxembourgeois et européen.

Compétences techniques

Gestion des risques

• Modélisation et validation des paramètres réglementaires (PD, LGD, EAD).
• Maîtrise des dispositifs de gestion des risques de crédit, de marché et opérationne
• Connaissance approfondie des méthodologies quantitatives appliquées au risque.
• Maîtrise des processus ICAAP, stress testing et dispositifs prudentiels.

Réglementation bancaire et prudentielle

• Bâle III / Bâle IV.
• CRD / CRR.
• Dispositifs de conformité et de gouvernance des risques.
• Réglementations applicables aux établissements bancaires, compagnies d'assurance et fonds d'investissement.

Finance

• Finance d'entreprise.
• Analyse financière.
• Valorisation et évaluation d'actifs.
• Normes IFRS appliquées aux instruments financiers.

Data & Outils Quantitatifs

• SAS.
• R.
• Python.
• MATLAB.
• Outils de modélisation et d'analyse statistique.

Compétences comportementales

• Leadership et capacité à fédérer les équipes.
• Excellent sens de la communication et de la relation client.
• Forte capacité d'analyse et de synthèse.
• Esprit entrepreneurial et orientation résultats.
• Autonomie et proactivité.
• Rigueur et sens de l'organisation.
• Capacité à évoluer dans des environnements exigeants et en constante évolution.
• Aptitude à gérer simultanément plusieurs projets stratégiques.

Compétences linguistiques

• Français, lu, écrit et parlé.
• Anglais, lu, écrit et parlé.

Pourquoi rejoindre Finegan Luxembourg ?

• Intervenir sur des projets stratégiques à forte valeur ajoutée.
• Évoluer dans un environnement stimulant au contact d'experts reconnus.
• Rejoindre un cabinet à taille humaine privilégiant proximité, excellence et développement professionnel.
• Participer activement aux transformations des principaux acteurs de la place financière luxembourgeoise.

Prema čl. 105. i 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10.,105/10.-ispr., 90/11., 5/12., 16/12., 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17 i 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23), sukladno Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN br. 6/19, 75/20) i temeljem Odluke o organizaciji i provedbi produženog boravka i cjelodnevnog odgojno-obrazovnog rada u osnovnim školama Grada Rijeke („Službene novine Grada Rijeke“ broj 4. – godina XII): - završen sveučilišni diplomski studij - potpuno vladanje talijanskim jezikom i pismom 2.   • presliku diplome, odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje i

Kandidati koji ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i priznatom statusu. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji su dostavili potpune i pravovremene prijave i koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja sudjeluju u daljnjem postupku te će biti pozvani na vrednovanje. Vrednovanje uključuje: psihologijsko testiranje, provjera poznavanja talijanskog jezika za kandidate koji nisu završili najmanje jedan obrazovni ciklus na talijanskom jeziku, sastav motivacijskog pisma i intervju, sve u skladu s odredbama članaka 12. – 14. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi – Scuola elementare „San Nicolò“. Nepotpune i nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Povjerenstvo za provedbu testiranja će postupiti sukladno odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u OŠ-SE „San Nicolò“ u odnosu na sve kandidate, koji udovoljavaju propisanim uvjetima, a podnijeli su potpune i pravovremene prijave. Kandidat koji se ne odazove pozivu za bilo koju fazu vrednovanja, smatrat će se da je odustao od daljnjeg natječajnog postupka. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka. Škola će u roku od 8 dana od donošenja odluke o izboru kandidata obavijestiti sve kandidate o rezultatima natječaja objavom odluke na mrežnoj stranici Škole ili osobno putem elektroničke pošte. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici škole, te na mrežnoj stranici Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje dana 10. rujna 2026. godine. Ai sensi dell'articolo 107 della Legge sull’educazione e l’istruzione nella scuola primaria e secondaria (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23 e 156/23) e in conformità al Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione e ai sensi dell'articolo 7 del Regolamento interno per l'assunzione del personale della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”, la direttrice della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò” di Fiume, Via Mirko Čurbeg 18, bandisce il C O N C O R S O per il posto di lavoro insegnante di classe al doposcuola in lingua italiana – orario completo, a tempo indeterminato – 2 persone, con la condizione del periodo di prova secondo il Contratto collettivo essenziale per gli ufficiali negli enti pubblici CONDIZIONI RICHIESTE: 1. Condizioni previste dagli articoli 105 e 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (GU 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-corr., 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23), in conformità al Regolamento sulla qualificha e preparazione psico-pedagogica dei docenti e collaboratori nell'istruzione elementare (GU 6/19, 75/20) e secondo la Decisione sull'organizzazione e sullo svolgimento del doposcuola e della scuola a tempo pieno nelle scuole elementari della Città di Fiume (Gazzetta ufficiale della Città di Fiume n. 4 – anno XII): - laurea - padronanza della lingua e della scrittura italiana 2. Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana,
  • il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 10 settembre 2026.

Condizioni specifiche in base alla Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione nella lingua e scrittura delle minoranze nazionali (GU 51/00, 56/00-corr.). Al Concorso possono partecipare i candidati di entrambi i sessi come previsto dall'articolo 13 della Legge sulle pari opportunità dei sessi (GU n. 82/16, 69/17). I termini usati in questo Bando di concorso si riferiscono a persone di entrambi i sessi. Le domande firmate devono essere corredate dalla seguente documentazione:
  • dati biografici (Curriculum vitae) redatti in lingua croata e in lingua italiana,
  • il Diploma di laurea, ovvero la prova attestante il grado d'istruzione e la qualifica professionale,
  • la prova di cittadinanza,
  • il Certificato/estratto digitale di dati dalla banca dati dell'HZMO e
  • l'attestato comprovante l'assenza di condanne penali considerate ostacoli per l'assunzione indicate nell'art. 106 della Legge sull'educazione e l'istruzione elementare e media superiore (con data di scadenza negli ultimi 6 mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del concorso).
La documentazione indicata deve pervenire all'indirizzo della scuola, consegnata personalmente o spedita per posta raccomandata, entro e non oltre il termine di 8 giorni dalla pubblicazione del presente Bando di Concorso sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato. I documenti vanno consegnati in copia non autenticata. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego, a parità di condizioni, in base a leggi specifiche, devono evocare questo diritto esplicitamente nella domanda e fornire in allegato oltre ai documenti comprovanti l'idoneità secondo i requisiti richesti, pure i documenti comprovanti lo status riconosciuto. Le persone di cui all'art.102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), art. 48. f della Legge sulla tutela degli invalidi di guerra militari e civili di (GU 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), art. 9 della Legge sulla riabilitazione professionale e l'impiego di persone disabili (GU 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) e l'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno comprovare il loro status con la documentazione indicata nella Legge speciale, che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nei confronti degli altri candidati esclusivamente alle stesse condizioni. I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego secondo l'art. 102 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari (GU 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dovranno allegare anche le prove indicate nell'art. 103, comma 1 della Legge sui veterani della guerra patriottica croata e dei loro familiari, che si trova sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje/Popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju.pdf I candidati che usufruiscono del diritto di precedenza nell'impiego in base all'art. 48 della Legge sugli invalidi civili della guerra patriottica croata (GU 84/21, 13/26), dovranno indicare questo diritto ed allegare le prove indicate nell'art. 49, comma 1 della stessa Legge, indicate sul ipercollegamento-link del Ministero dei difensori: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf I candidati che hanno inoltrato le domande complete e tempestive e che soddisfano le condizioni formali del concorso partecipano nella procedura ulteriore e saranno invitati alla prova (test). La prova (test) include: test psicologici, verifiche della conoscenza della lingua italiana per coloro che non hanno finito almeno un ciclo di istruzione in lingua italiana, la stesura della lettera motivazionale ed il colloquio, tutto indicato ai sensi degli articoli 12 – 14 del Regolamento sulle modalità e sulla procedura di assunzione della OŠ-SE “San Nicolò”. Le domande incomplete e non pervenute entro il termine stabilito non verranno prese in considerazione. La Commissione che svolge le prove (test) per le assunzioni procederà secondo le regole stabilite dal Regolamento sulle modalità e procedure di assunzione dell'OŠ-SE »San Nicolò« con tutti i candidati che soddisferanno le condizioni formali richieste e che presenteranno domande complete, entro il termine previsto. Se il candidato non accede a una delle fasi della prova (test) si considererà come se avesse rinunciato alla procedura concorsuale ulteriore. Accedendo al Bando di concorso i candidati danno il proprio consenso all'elaborazione dei dati personali presenti in tutti i documenti allegati. La Scuola avviserà tutti i candidati riguardo ai risultati del concorso, entro 8 giorni dalla data della decisione sulla scelta del candidato, pubblicando la decisione sul sito web della Scuola oppure personalmente tramite posta elettronica. Il Bando di concorso è stato pubblicato sul sito web della Scuola e sul sito web dell'Ufficio collocamento croato il 10 settembre 2026.

jobs.title: UREĐIVAČ/ICA VIDEOZAPISA / SADRŽAJA ZA DRUŠTVENE MREŽE
jobs.description:
Tražimo junior content creatora / video editora Rvstica (sapunerija.com) traži vrijednu i odgovornu osobu koja voli snimati i montirati video sadržaj. Moguće korištenje mjera aktivne politike zapošljavanja. Uvjeti radnog mjesta:
  • Puno radno vrijeme
  • Fleksibilno radno vrijeme
  • Plaća 1100 eura neto, dodatni bonus u postotku od konverzije ostvarene putem videa koje osoba snimi i montira.
  • Početak rada 1.10. 2026.
  • Potreban vlastiti prijevoz, zato je dobro imati osobni automobil.
Opis posla:
  • Snimanje kratkih video sadržaja za Reels, TikTok i Stories: proizvodnja sapuna, uživo radionice izrade sapuna, priroda, "behind the scenes", UGC videi s korištenjem proizvoda, priče o proizvodu.
  • Montiranje videa u CapCutu, uz dinamične rezove, titlove i ubacivanje slika.
  • Pisanje scenarija prema zadanim edukacijama, uz praćenje trendova na Instagramu i TikToku i predlaganje ideja za sadržaj.
  • Snimanje se odvija u Tučepima, dok se video montaža radi kod kuće.
Koga tražimo:
  • Osobu s osjećajem za vizualno pripovijedanje i ritam montaže, s iskustvom ili jakim interesom za CapCut i format Reels/TikTok.
  • Kreativnu, samoinicijativnu osobu s okom za detalje, vrijednu i marljivu, spremnu puno učiti i savladati edukacije koje odredimo. Prethodno profesionalno iskustvo nije potrebno.
  • Poželjno je poznavanje osnova marketinga društvenih mreža, fotografije i rada s kamerom, mobitel je dovoljan za početak. Zanimanje za prirodnu kozmetiku, održivost i "slow living" estetiku predstavlja prednost ali nije nužno.
Poslodavac nudi:
  • Rad na autentičnom, vizualno bogatom terenu (proizvodnja sapuna, maslinici, radionice izrade sapuna, konoba), kreativnu slobodu u oblikovanju sadržaja, plaćene edukacije video editinga i marketinga općenito, te dodatni bonus u postotku od konverzije videa.
  • Osobi koja pokaže rezultate i želju za razvojem nudimo mogućnost napredovanja unutar brenda, povećanje plaće uz kontinuirano mentorstvo i vođenje kroz edukacije.
Prijave slati na mail

jobs.title: Finance Head (f/m/d) - Discrete Projects Industrial Logistics (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
We're seeking a Finance Head (f/m/d) for Industrial Logistics within Digital Industries Automation Discrete Projects (DI AUT DP). In this role, you'll lead global financial management for our Industrial Logistics (IL) project business across Europe and Americas – as part of the global Finance function under our new ONE Tech Company structure.
This is your chance to shape financial operations throughout the complete project lifecycle – from bid calculations to project closure – while ensuring IFRS 15 compliance, financial performance analysis, and effective risk management. You’ll drive profitable growth, sustainable margin improvement, stable cash generation, and financial resilience through disciplined risk control across multiple countries. You'll work in a transformation environment with a clear focus on business growth, where your financial expertise directly contributes to our goals of speed, scale, and efficiency.
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career. From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.
You’ll make an impact by - Financial Leadership & Strategy: You lead global financial management and controlling for the Industrial Logistics project business, reporting to the Head of Finance of DI AUT DP. You drive growth and productivity initiatives to strengthen its competitive position. You govern the adoption of finance and controlling policies and guidelines based on the overall FIN strategy while ensuring compliance with all relevant financial regulations (external and internal).- Budget Planning, Forecasting & Financial Reporting: You coordinate budget planning and forecasting for the entire IL project business, ensuring IFRS-compliant accounting and timely preparation of financial closings as well as accurate books and records (monthly, quarterly, annual).- Performance Monitoring: You monitor and comment on financial performance (current development and outlook) incl. KPI analyses and performance reporting. You analyze, approve, review and forecast project revenues and costs, and ensure accurate profitability throughout the project lifecycle, as well as initiate early warnings to stakeholders when needed.- Project Finance & Risk Management: You identify and manage financial risks associated with the execution of projects, including currency, credit, and operational risks, ensuring proper risk assessment and provisioning in calculations and financial statements.- Operational Improvement & Innovation: You identify operational improvement potentials in controlling and financial processes, propose solutions and remedial measures, and drive productivity improvements through automation and innovation initiatives.- Collaboration & Transformation: You work with IL management, operational leadership, and central finance functions while supporting organizational transformation by challenging the current processes and collaborating across all stakeholder groups (e.g., FIN, P&O, EHS, GBS, SCM).- Team Leadership & Development: Finally, you manage and develop Finance and Controlling teams supporting the global IL project business. Traveling to its locations and project sites is necessary.

Your success is grounded in- Education: University degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, or related field - Experience and Skills:- Minimum 8-10 years in Finance, Controlling, and FP&A, preferably in international project business- Minimum 5 years leadership experience leading finance teams across multiple locations and building collaborative relationships - Proven expertise in IFRS 15 revenue recognition for long-term project contracts and commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations. Familiarity with project business models in automotive or comparable industrial environments is a strong differentiator.- Demonstrated hands-on experience in commercial contract negotiations with OEM procurement organizations, covering pricing structures, risk allocation, liability caps, and penalty/malus clauses. Ability to engage with customer purchasing teams and to represent Finance as a value-creating business partner in complex commercial discussions.- Strong knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and controlling- Deep understanding of risk management, internal controls, compliance and audit requirements- Proficiency with ERP systems (SAP preferred) and advanced MS Office skills- Experience with organizational transformation and implementation of new business operations is beneficial

- Ways of Working:- Strategic vision meets financial excellence – combining big-picture thinking with process optimization and attention to detail- Collaborative influencer who builds trust across cultures and translates complex financial insights into clear, actionable messages- Proactive, adaptable, and able to thrive in evolving business environments - High integrity with commitment to Siemens Business Conduct Guidelines and compliance requirements
- Languages: Business proficiency in English; German language skills are a plus. Additional languages are highly welcome and beneficial for international collaboration.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!
Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us. As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/about/social-commitments/belonging/) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.
About us.
We know that our business thrives only when our people thrive and unlock their full potential. That’s why you are always our top priority. Our global, diverse team is ready to support, challenge, and inspire you, helping you grow in countless ways. Together, we’ll embark on an exciting journey of discovery. Who knows where this path will lead? Join us and take an active role in shaping your future!

jobs.title: Erfaren cykelmekaniker med sans for salg søges
jobs.description:
Vi søger ikke bare en mekaniker – vi søger den person, der kan blive butikkens ansigt udadtil og tage ansvar, som var det sin egen forretning.

Er du en dygtig og selvstændig cykelmekaniker med solid erfaring? Trives du med ansvar, kundekontakt og en varieret hverdag, hvor du selv er med til at få butikken til at fungere? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en erfaren cykelmekaniker, der kan tage ansvar for både butik og værksted i det daglige. Du skal være tryg ved at arbejde selvstændigt og kunne håndtere alt fra almindelige serviceeftersyn til fejlfinding og større reparationer på alle typer cykler, herunder ladcykler - har du erfaring med elcykler, er det et plus.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

* Har flere års erfaring som cykelmekaniker.

* Kan diagnosticere og løse alle typer mekaniske problemer på cykler.

* Er vant til at arbejde alene og tage ansvar for dagens opgaver.

* Er serviceminded og god til at rådgive kunder.

* Arbejder struktureret, effektivt og med fokus på kvalitet.

* Forstår at mersalg er en del af servicen.

Vi tilbyder

* En konkurrencedygtig løn, der matcher dine kvalifikationer.

* En varieret hverdag i en lille, lokal cykelbutik i Søborg.

* Stor frihed under ansvar og mulighed for at præge den daglige drift.

* Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med korte beslutningsveje.

* Mulighed for at blive en vigtig del af en butik, hvor godt håndværk og god kundeservice er i fokus. Vi sætter pris på vores ⭐️'er.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning og dit CV på mailen nedenunder. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Michelle Rasmussen

JM Cykler

kontakt@jmcykler.dk
