Lead, safeguard and develop Aiglon’s sports and activities provision so that every pupil, staff member and guest enjoys an inclusive, high-quality and safe programme.

Ensure effective and timely communication of information to students, staff and the wider community
Provide leadership, guidance and support to staff for effective programme planning, scheduling and execution
In collaboration with the Director of Character and the Head of Junior Activities, have a clear overall strategy in line with the schools mission for both the development and participation of our students in activities for enjoyment and lifelong engagement
Create energy and dynamism within activities and manage the day-to-day operation of the programme
Ensure that an effective activities programme exists to develop the leadership of our students

Ensure that all students and parents are aware that activities are a school requirement and to provide the necessary support and guidance on how to use SOCs to make it possible for all students to engage and sign up to activities they are interested in
Work with the Director of Character and Educational Systems to continue to develop the processes and systems of SOCs to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the services delivered

Ensuring ongoing innovation, engagement and development so the students have access to a broad, balanced and constantly evolving programme of activities

Administration

Contribute to staff CPD by running short workshops on fitness, wellbeing or safe practice
OTHER TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
To be available for School sporting events such as inter-house and inter-school competitions, Sports day and other major events

Desirable

jobs.title: Senior Packaging Technician, Operations (m/f/d) - [R408196]
jobs.description:
The Senior Packaging Technician is responsible for independently executing clinical packaging activities in compliance with internal specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), batch records and applicable Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP)/ Good Documentation Practice (GDP) and Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) requirements. This role performs primary and secondary packaging, operates packaging and labelling systems, supports documentation and SAP transactions, coordinates routine technical tasks within assigned studies and serves as an experienced technical point of contact for day-to-day packaging activities.  

Key Responsibilities:

1. Clinical Packaging Operations
•    Performs primary packaging of clinical studies according to internal specifications, SOPs and batch records.
•    Performs secondary packaging of clinical studies according to internal specifications, SOPs and batch records.
•    Supplies ordered study material to the corresponding packaging rooms and prepares materials in accordance with the relevant SOPs.
•    Operates packaging and labelling systems in support of clinical packaging activities.

2. Technical Coordination
•    Trains and supports new technicians during onboarding and routine operations.
•    Performs administrative work related to packaging orders and clinical packaging activities.
•    Escalates problems directly to the supervisor or manager as required.
•    Coordinates the execution of bottle filling, labelling and packaging activities for clinical studies.
•    Oversees compliance-related aspects of packaging orders and serves as a technical point of contact for technicians assigned to individual studies.
•    Performs cleaning verification for equipment and rooms and completes final cleaning verification at study closeout.
•    Executes SAP transactions related to packaging activities.
•    Prepares GMP documentation, including required photographs, and creates batch notes or comments as applicable.
•    Reviews and coordinates Packaging Technicians’ activities within the assigned area.
•    Supports the transfer of cold materials as required during daily operations.  
•    Ensures study completion and hands over completed studies to the supervisor.

3. Routine Operational Tasks
•    Performs or coordinates routine tasks such as scale adjustments, deionized water flushes, and replenishment of consumables to support operational readiness.  
•    Provides day-to-day operational support to ensure readiness of packaging rooms, equipment and materials.
•    Supports the Packaging Compliance Support team with batch pre- and post-execution reviews.  

4. Documentation & Systems
•    Assists in document preparation, control and process improvement for packaging activities.
•    Uses SAP, Word and Excel for documentation and operational support, including the accurate completion of electronic logs.
•    Ensures accurate and compliant use of SAP for clinical packaging processes.

5. Compliance & EHS
•    Performs all activities in compliance with applicable SOPs, company policies, and GMP/GDP/EHS requirements.
•    Documents activities in accordance with internal GDP requirements.
•    Conducts blinding checks in accordance with SOP requirements.  

Your Profile:

•    Completed apprenticeship, preferably in a life sciences-related field.
•    At least 3 years of experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, clinical packaging, or a comparable GMP-regulated environment.  
•    Good understanding of GMP, GDP and EHS requirements relevant to packaging operations.
•    English language proficiency at B1/ B2 level or above.
•    Hands-on experience with packaging and labelling equipment and routine operational support activities.
•    Experience with documentation practices, batch records and accurate recording of operational activities.
•    Proficiency in SAP and Microsoft Office applications such as Word and Excel.
•    Ability to train and support other technicians and to serve as a technical point of contact for assigned studies.  
•    Reliable, detail-oriented and able to work independently while following procedures and compliance requirements.
•    Demonstrates strong ethics, compliance and quality mindset.
•    Strong team player with a collaborative mindset.  
•    Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset in day-to-day operations and supports the implementation of procedural changes.

THE COMPANY

Our Company is a leading biopharmaceutical company employing over 1,000 people in Switzerland at three sites. The company’s headquarters are in Lucerne. At the site in Zurich, the company operates a global innovation and development hub. In addition, we manufacture medicines for global clinical trials and operate a forensic laboratory in Schachen (Canton Lucerne). We conduct around 40 clinical trials annually in Switzerland. The main therapeutic areas include oncology, infectious diseases, cardiovascular and cardiometabolic diseases. We also have a broad portfolio of vaccines for the prevention of diseases in children, adolescents, and adults and we are one of the leading companies in veterinary medicine. Furthermore, we take our responsibility to the local community seriously and have been involved for many years in initiatives such as the «Trendtage Gesundheit Luzern» and the «Alliance Health Competence».  

We are proud to be certified as a “Top Employer Switzerland” and “Top Employer Europe” showing the company’s commitment to our employees and the community around us.

Our Werthenstein BioPharma site in Schachen is where we conduct cutting-edge research, develop and analyze new biological agents and supply clinical trial products for global clinical studies. The site is also home to one of our global forensic laboratories where we carefully monitor our products through the supply chain to ensure security and safety for our patients.

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

jobs.title: Commercial Excellence Lead (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Within the Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EEMEA). Commercial Operations & Strategy Organization, the Commercial Excellence Lead will elevate commercial excellence across the region, enable strong alignment across multiple functions and divisions, and lead commercial-capability readiness for our emerging launch pipeline in EEMEA. Strong, trusted partnership with cluster commercial operations teams is essential to the success of this role. Key stakeholders will be the EEMEA Leadership Team (LT), HHI Commercial Operations, regional Chief Marketing Officers (CMO) & Regional Commercial Leads (RCL), and market Commercial Operations Directors (CODs.)
This is a Band 400 individual-contributor role. The primary location is Switzerland, with secondary locations in the Europe or Middle East time zones may be considered upon further discussion with the hiring manager. The role includes approximately 25% travel within Eastern Europe, Middle East, and Africa.
Responsibilities:
Commercial Capabilities:  Drive customer engagement evolution in partnership with Digital Engagement teams, ensuring commercial capabilities, segmentation, omnichannel execution and customer insights are translated into improved customer experience and business outcomes.
Relevant focus areas include:
•    Sales Force Effectiveness: Ensure proper Sales Incentive Plan (SIP), target setting, CRM operations and upgrades, and Sales Force of the Future (SFOF) deployment in select markets.  Ensure an ongoing focus on segmentation and targeting and Multichannel Cycle Plans (MCCP) efforts in the region.  Leverage data, analytics and business insights to improve sales force effectiveness in the region.
•    Key Account Management:  Ensure the roll out of Key Account Management and Top Customer programs in the region. Ensure successful capability roll-out and work with Market Access and Franchises to increase access at account level.
•    Commercial Trade Channels: Align with HHI on new capability roll-out and support markets in uncovering Commercial Trade Channel (CTC) opportunities.
Operational Governance & Execution:  Work with all relevant stakeholders to secure the EEMEA Commercial Operations & Strategy (CO&S) vision and business strategies and proactively identify and execute projects and programs of strategic importance to the region and our customers in a timely, effective, and efficient fashion. Be the communicator / connector / catalyst for cross-functional projects managed by extended regional stakeholders. Relevant focus areas include:
•    CO&S Governance: Manage all governance activities for the CO&S department, including setting the agenda for virtual and face-to-face meetings and periodic forum calls with market leads and other relevant stakeholders.
•    Business Impact Measurement: Establish measurement frameworks to evaluate the impact of commercial capability investments, ensuring visibility to adoption, effectiveness, customer outcomes and business value realization.
•    Continuous Improvement: Continue to identify opportunities to drive simplification and harmonization across the region in collaboration with CO&S stakeholders including Digital Human Health (DHH). Support markets and the region in Objective & Key Result (OKR) transformation projects where requested.  Bring external industry best practices and innovative approaches into the region to continuously elevate commercial excellence.
•    Marketing Capabilities: Partner with regional Learning & Development (L&D), CMOs, and RCLs to build and scale marketing capabilities with a focus on L3 next deployment and sustainment.
•    Regional Projects: Ensure the successful deployment of projects associated with regional initiatives, priorities, and experimentations.
Launch Excellence:  Lead commercial-capability readiness that carries our emerging pipeline to flawless launch execution across markets. Relevant focus areas include:
•    Launch Capability Readiness: Partner with RCLs and market teams to ensure markets have the appropriate Go to Market (G2M) planning, segmentation, targeting, field-force sizing, training, forecasting support, and launch playbooks are in place well ahead of launch.
•    Launch Framework & Tracking: Establish a repeatable EEMEA launch-excellence framework and toolkit, with launch tracking that gives leadership visibility to timelines, milestones and risks.
AI-Enabled Commercial Excellence:  Champion the responsible adoption of GenAI across commercial workflows — helping teams work faster and smarter while safeguarding compliance and quality — and explore opportunities to embed AI into sales, marketing, field-force and launch ways of working, in partnership with key stakeholders.
Talent Development:  Build & support commercial-operations talent and capability development across the region.
We are looking for a commercially minded leader with 10+ years across sales, marketing, commercial operations and launch readiness who has successfully deployed commercial excellence capabilities in a complex, multinational environment. Combines strategic thinking with execution discipline, excels at influencing without authority, and has a strong track record of leading change, building capabilities, and translating data and technology into measurable business outcomes.

Company Description

At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest.

Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Magazine, and it has been awarded with the "Friendly Work Space" label to all its Swiss sites.


Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Data Scientist (m/f/d) with deep expertise in developing multi-omics data integration and machine learnings methods, to join our Digital & Data Science Group in Biologicals Research. Biologicals research discovers, characterizes, optimizes and produces novel biologicals. Biologicals are derived from nature. They can be naturally occurring microbes, extracts or molecules protecting plants from pests and diseases or improving plant and soil health.
Within this role you will work on Syngenta ‘omics data to identify patterns in product performance and make predictions. You will be asked to develop methods to analyze and interpret the outcome of ‘omics experiments with your analytical skills as well as machine learning approaches. Your work will result in new tools to guide selection, optimization and development of novel Biologicals solutions.

Key responsibilities will include:

Develop and implement new multi-omics integration strategies (e.g., data harmonization, feature engineering, network-based methods) to strengthen biological interpretation and hypothesis generation
Apply and advance machine learning, statistical modeling, and AI approaches to extract insights from complex, high‑dimensional, multi‑omics datasets
Curate, quality control, and integrate large scale ’omics datasets, ensuring data integrity, reproducibility, and downstream analytical readiness
Evaluate and develop new data analysis tools, validate findings using a trial and iterative approach, and effectively communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences
Identify data needs and provide recommendations to scientists to ensure the quantity and verify the integrity of data used for analyses
Work collaboratively to deliver new approaches, share learnings, and drive innovation in digital and data science including technology foresight
Work with R&D IT and software developers to deploy predictive model applications tailored to stakeholder needs
Support business users with change management initiatives to manage data more effectively

Qualifications:

MSc or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Computational Biology, Bioinformatics, or related field with some experience in natural sciences (e.g. chemical biology, microbiology, ecology, environmental sciences)
3+ years developing multi-omics integration methods for complex biological, biochemical, environmental, or agricultural datasets
Strong proficiency in Python and/or R, UNIX/Linux environments, ML frameworks, SQL
Experience with proteomics and metabolomics data analysis would be an asset
Dynamic personality with passion for innovation and problem-solving

Additional information:

We offer a variety of financial and non-financial benefits including:

A position which contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment
A superb working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce where new ideas are always welcome
The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced employees and gain scientific and technical excellence
Learning culture (Together we Grow) and wide range of training options
You will profit from a competitive pension fund plan, flexible working, attractive bonus system, onsite doctor, fitness room, canteen, and other benefits such as Family friendly initiatives, Child and Family allowance
Please send your complete application with CV, a motivation letter that highlights your motivation and relevant experience for this position, diploma and work certificates (if applicable) in English. Additionally, we welcome access to git repositories showcasing relevant past projects. We will only consider applications that contain CV and motivation letters.

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
jobs.description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position

IBU - Oveporexton Access Business Partner

- Serve as primary point of contact for IBU Local Access teams for Oveporexton; drive access and pricing strategy execution to enable timely patient access, including P&R success through strong HTA readiness and payer negotiation preparedness, as well as sustained value maximization across life cycle management.

- Support contracting / access levers where relevant (e.g., VBC, Entry agreements, business cases development, patient support approaches), aligned to compliance requirements and corporate governance.
- Ensure reporting and transparency of access strategy execution and pricing actions, reimbursement status, payer risks, and readiness KPIs for senior leadership.
- Develop an updated IBU access strategy by systematically integrating key insights from leading international congresses and external payer forums within the relevant therapeutic area.
- Proactively foster a growth mindset across and beyond P&R/HTA requirements by encouraging Takeda’s access community to engage with the broader external healthcare ecosystem, including patient voice and services, medical partners to leverage further real-world evidence (RWE) and data generation initiatives, publication planning, to adopt digitalization opportunities, and to systematically apprehend evolving legislative developments.
- Manage and coordinate budget for assigned assets.

GPA / Global Collaboration
- Work closely with Global Pricing & Access Strategy teams to support Pricing & Access optimization by developing analysis, contributing to pricing research, and ensuring P&R guidance is implemented consistently across the IBU.
- Anticipate LOE, biosimilar/generic impact, expansion of indication, external pressure, and competitive responses unique to the TA working closely with the LOE offices.
- Act as a core member of cross‑functional teams, working with global and IBU partners (Commercial, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, HEOR, Global Access & Pricing, Pipeline, etc.) to embed access considerations into key strategic decisions.
- Connect local, IBU, and global teams to strengthen the value proposition through fit‑for‑purpose deliverables (e.g., value dossiers, health economic evidence, objection handler, negotiation playbook, training) that improve value perception and ensure consistent, high‑quality execution across markets.
- Collaborate with medical and evidence generation / HEOR teams to identify evidence gaps and integrate timely access needs within the evidence strategy, ensuring new clinical data and RWE strengthens payer value narratives (contributing to business cases to support prioritization of evidence generation as needed).

Future Readiness / capability
- Monitor and interpret market access trends, reimbursement policy changes, and coverage decisions; identify payer evidence gaps; and translate insights into actions on emerging opportunities and risks, in partnership with GPA access strategy and pipeline teams.
- Lead a multi‑layer TA Access function across the IBU to ensure cross‑market consistency, execution excellence, share practices and accelerated access outcomes; define TA‑specific capabilities and implement the agreed operating model in partnership with Global Access, Global Pricing, IBU Medical, MCE, and IBU Regulatory.
- Equip, guide and train local teams/partners with processes, standards, tools, and decision frameworks to build high-quality LOCs access excellence in execution.
-Lead and be a role model to digital capability adoption throughout the access community
- Develop and run mock negotiations within the specific TA and orchestrate capability training, and simulation exercises for markets.
- Foster collaboration and best practice sharing across GPA teams, access and cross-functions and geographies partners.
- Lead and contribute to strategic initiatives sponsored by the GPA function or Takeda, broadening organizational impact, strengthening cross-functional alignment, and driving enterprise value (mAI access – CXF – JHTA – VBHC ...)

Skills:
- Solid experience in Local and preferably Regional Market Access & Pricing, with demonstrated leadership across TA areas and complex payer environments.
- Proven ability to shape TA‑level access strategy across the full asset lifecycle (launch, inline, LOE), including advisory to senior governance bodies.
- Deep knowledge of global payer systems, reimbursement pathways and pricing dynamics, particularly across Europe and Intercontinental markets.
- Strong portfolio readiness expertise, including payer scenario planning, pricing insights & trends, evidence requirements, and competitive access risk management.
- Advanced capability to integrate clinical, HEOR, RWE and competitive insights into clear payer value propositions and access decision‑making.
- Demonstrated matrix leadership, working effectively with Global Access, Pricing, Medical, Regulatory and Commercial partners and being at ease to navigate a complex matrix of multi stakeholders.
- Project/program management and prioritization capability across parallel workstreams and deadlines.
- People and capability cross-functional influencing experience, including leading multi‑layer, geographically dispersed Access teams and driving functional capability development.
- Learning agility to adapt to new assets within the assigned TA, portfolio or any new situation, continuing to lead within changes and uncertainties and deliver results.
- Strategic thinking: Ability to think strategically and make sound, forward-looking decisions, based on strong business acumen to identify challenges and opportunities and drive impact.
- Communication: Ability to communicate effectively and influence diverse global and Local stakeholders with strong interpersonal and influencing skills in a multicultural, international environment and proven ability to build alignment.
- Resilience with ambiguity and cross-cultural collaboration across international markets/partners.

jobs.title: Principal Process Chemist Specialist

jobs.description:
At Syngenta Group, we're a global community of 56,000 innovators across 90 countries, united by a 250-year legacy of agricultural excellence. As the world's most local agricultural technology partner, we create tailor-made solutions that transform farming while protecting our planet, driven by our commitment to innovation, ethics, and integrity. Responsible for execution of Gasoline Blending operations and trader support. The role co-ordinates all aspects of post-deal trading activity to ensure contract execution runs efficiently, provides commercial and market information to the trader as necessary, and reviews and comments on contracts and tenders to ensure consistency with the trade ticket and recap.

For all Gasoline blended cargoes, be the key point of contact between the commercial desk and external stakeholders.
Liaise with terminals and vessels to ensure commercial blending plans are followed in line with the traders’ expectations.
Ensure with inspection companies that quality is as per blend plans and in line with contractual provisions.
Investigate Quantity losses and explore remedial action.
Trouble shoot when plans change and provide solutions.
Actively manage the terminals line up to mitigate demurrage.
Review stowage plans and monitor vessel progress during voyages.
Appoint third-party providers in line with group policy; oversee clean acceptance of vessels on subjects and chartering progress.
Liaise and co-ordinate with Finance, providing accurate and timely data needed for the issuance of L/Cs and P/Us.
Issue documentary instructions to suppliers and handle all aspects of customs exportation/importation where applicable.
Maintain good contract and shipping files electronically; keep Pluto updated regularly and minimise exceptions.
Complete voyage and storage reconciliations to identify and investigate loss/gain differences for each operation.
Monitor and advise the deals desk of all costs related to each transaction, maintaining P&L awareness.
Ensure operations are optimised to best commercial advantage, meeting all contractual obligations (e.g. minimising demurrage exposure).
Maximise recoveries; document, present and secure payment of all claims to third parties.
Maintain strong working relationships with trade support divisions — claims, deals desk, trade finance and chartering — and with counterparts and third-party service providers.
Train and develop less experienced members of the operations team to increase knowledge and commercial awareness.
Follow internal procedures and company policies; adhere to Trafigura's Code of Conduct, HSEC Policy and Business Principles.
Identify operational issues and escalate to the Regional Manager as appropriate.

Required qualifications
At least 5 years' experience in cargo operations in a global oil trading company.
Experience working on Gasoline cargo operations with a preference for experience with blending operations.
Ability to interpret the operational requirements of contracts and comment on operational aspects; understanding of the basic legal framework supporting oil contracts.
Ability to interpret charter party terms against the interacting oil contract; good understanding of common ship operations and terminology.
Good understanding of relevant petroleum product specifications, analytical methods, laboratory precision and inspection procedures.
Good understanding of different types of financial instruments, their uses, and the importance of LOIs and shipping documents within the trading process.

Preferred qualifications
Experience across multiple product desks (Gasoline, Distillates and Fuel Oil).
Familiarity with Pluto or similar trade operations management systems.
Exposure to storage logistics and reconciliation processes.

Attributes for success
Strong decision-making ability — comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-moving trading environment.
Effective networker who builds and maintains relationships with counterparts, service providers and internal stakeholders.
Organised and detail-oriented, with strong planning and prioritisation skills.
Resourceful and commercially aware, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Department overview
The Oil Cargo Operations department is responsible for the efficient and effective management of the physical movement of oil and petroleum products. The team ensures commodities are transported from origin to destination, meeting all contractual obligations and regulatory requirements. The department works closely with Traders, Finance, Deals Desk (Risk and P&L) and Chartering to support the full trade lifecycle.

jobs.title: Dispute and Chargebacks, Program Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Role Summary

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

As a Disputes and Chargeback Program Manager at Replit, you’ll be part of our Trust and Safety Operations team, who owns customer-facing workflows that handle sensitive and policy-driven interactions across the Support organization. This includes areas such as privacy requests, DMCA and intellectual property claims, law enforcement requests, and abuse appeals.

You'll own Replit's disputes and chargeback function end-to-end: from the individual case in front of you to the policies, playbooks, and automation that let it hold up as we scale to millions of users. This role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution: you'll determine dispute and chargeback strategy, and build the systems that make those decisions repeatable at scale, working closely with Engineering, Legal and Finance.

 

In this role you will…

 - Own the full dispute lifecycle: investigate incoming chargebacks and disputes, decide whether and how to represent, gather evidence, and respond within network deadlines.

 - Design and maintain the policies, decision trees, and SOPs that govern how disputes and chargebacks are handled.

 - Define the key metrics, health targets, and goals for the disputes program and track performance against them, reporting to leadership.

 - Monitor chargeback rates and dispute trends to identify the underlying drivers of volume, and partner with Engineering and Finance to address root causes.

 - Partner with Engineering and Support Operations to automate manual parts of the workflow (evidence gathering, decisioning logic, etc).

 - Build training, documentation, and escalation paths that enable frontline support teams to handle dispute-related inquiries confidently and consistently as the program scales.



Required Skills and Experience:

 - 6+ years of hands-on experience owning disputes/chargebacks operations, ideally where you built or significantly leveled up the function rather than just running an existing one.

 - Deep familiarity with major card network dispute rules and reason codes (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), including compelling-evidence frameworks and network monitoring/excessive-dispute programs (e.g., Visa's VDMP/VFMP, Mastercard's ECP)

 - Experience building or improving SOPs, playbooks, or workflows in a support or operations environment.

 - Experience partnering with Engineering to scope and prioritize automation, even if you're not writing the code yourself.

 - Comfort operating as both a hands-on operator and systems builder in a scaling environment.

 - Strong judgment and decision-making skills when handling sensitive or ambiguous customer situations.

 - Experience translating policy or legal requirements into clear, repeatable processes or customer-facing guidance.

 - Strong written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, empathetically, and precisely in high-stakes situations.

 - Proven track record working cross-functionally to deliver impactful results.

 

Nice to Have:

 - Hands-on experience with Stripe's dispute tooling specifically, including submitting evidence and managing dispute workflows through Stripe.

jobs.title: Senior/Media Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit is investing seriously in paid media — TV, CTV, online video, out-of-home, audio, social, and search — and we need the person who makes that investment work. This role is the internal owner of our media program: you'll direct our external media agencies, pressure-test their plans, steward the budget, and hold every dollar accountable for reaching the right audiences on the right channels at the right time.

You'll report to the VP of Marketing and act as the connective tissue between our brand and growth teams and our agency partners. This is not a hands-on-keyboard activation role. You won't be living in Ads Manager — you'll be the person who briefs the agency, challenges the channel mix, catches the pacing problem before it becomes a budget problem, and translates campaign performance into decisions leadership can act on.

This is the right role if you've sat on the brand side (or want to move there from a media agency), you know what a great media plan looks like and what a lazy one looks like, and you get energy from being the sharpest media mind in the room without needing to touch the platforms yourself.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Agency leadership: Serve as the primary day-to-day partner to our media agencies. Set strategy direction, write clear briefs, run planning cycles and QBRs, and hold partners accountable for performance, optimization, quality, and business results.

 - Plan interrogation: Review and challenge agency recommendations across every channel — TV, CTV, OLV, OOH, audio, social, search, programmatic. Catch weak rationale, frequency saturation risks, and budget misallocations before plans get approved.

 - Budget stewardship: Own media budget pacing, forecasting, authorizations, and reconciliation in partnership with Finance. Monitor spend and delivery mid-flight, flag risks early, and drive reallocations when the data says to.

 - Media strategy & planning: Lead annual, quarterly, and campaign-level planning with the agency. Make sure plans reflect our audiences, product moments, competitive pressure, and business goals — not just what's easy to buy.

 - Measurement & accountability: Define campaign KPIs and measurement frameworks with the agency and our analytics team. Own wrap reports, drive a test-and-learn agenda (incrementality, brand lift, MMM as we scale), and go beyond CPMs and impressions to reach efficiency and cost-per-outcome.

 - Executive reporting: Distill campaign and channel performance into clear recommendations for marketing leadership. Tell us what worked, what didn't, and what we should do differently — with numbers behind it.

 - Cross-functional alignment: Partner with Brand, Growth, Creative, Product Marketing, Social, and Comms so media plans amplify what the rest of marketing is building, and so creative assets fit the placements we're buying.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of media planning and strategy experience, either brand-side managing external agencies or at a media agency serving major consumer brands

 - Demonstrated experience independently reviewing and challenging agency media plans, not just executing against them

 - Experience managing multi-million dollar media budgets across concurrent campaigns, including pacing, forecasting, and mid-flight reallocation

 - Fluency across the full channel landscape: TV/CTV, online video, OOH, audio/podcasts, paid social, search, and programmatic — you can evaluate rates, rationale, and audience fit in any of them

 - Strong command of media measurement: reach and frequency, brand lift, incrementality testing, and marketing mix modeling

 - Sharp analytical skills; you can work from raw campaign data to find performance trends and budget inefficiencies, and you're at home in Excel

 - Strong stakeholder management across Finance, Analytics, Creative, and agency teams; you write briefs people can actually work from

 - AI-native: actively using AI tools to speed up analysis, reporting, and planning work — you're not just aware of them, you're using them daily

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity and at speed; you don't need committee consensus to make smart decisions



BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience at a high-growth consumer tech, B2C, or AI company

 - Agency alumni who've made (or want to make) the move to the client side

 - Experience standing up a media function or measurement framework from scratch

 - Experience with OOH and large cultural-moment buys (sponsorships, tentpole events)

 - A point of view on how AI is changing media planning and buying — and what most brands get wrong about it

 - Active Replit user; you've built and shipped something with the product

 - Based in or able to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
About us

HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People

With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact

Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. Weâre proud to be a part of that.Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Role

We are seeking a Lead Product Designer who can elevate HighLevel's product experiences through exceptional craft, product vision, systems thinking and influence. You have spent 7+ years designing complex digital products, ideally including SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or similarly sophisticated product experiences, and are ready to shape product direction, design standards and team culture across one or more product pillars.

As a lead individual contributor, you will partner deeply with product and engineering leaders, mentor other designers and help teams define and improve strategically important product experiences across the HighLevel platform. You will connect customer needs, business goals, technical constraints and long-term product strategy to clear, useful and highly polished product design.

We expect candidates at this level to demonstrate an extraordinarily high bar for design craft and visual sophistication, and to raise that bar for the teams around them. You should care deeply about hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, interaction quality, usability, accessibility and the standards that make product experiences feel refined, trustworthy and coherent at scale. We want candidates who can ship truly world-class product design.

Experience using AI-powered tools for exploration, prototyping, critique, synthesis or workflow acceleration is mandatory. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

What You Can Expect

  • Autonomy to shape design direction across one or more strategically important product pillars.

  • Meaningful influence with product, engineering and senior leadership on product quality, customer outcomes and roadmap direction.

  • The opportunity to raise the design bar across multiple teams through critique, standards, mentorship and systems thinking.

  • Partnership with ambitious product, engineering, data and design peers who value clarity, speed, craft and customer outcomes.

  • A craft-forward design culture where lead designers help strengthen design practice, improve team rituals and grow other designers.

  • A 100% remote environment where distributed collaboration is normal. Employees in all geographies are expected to be flexible and thoughtful about working hours so US- and India-based colleagues can collaborate effectively.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of relevant product design experience, with 2+ years in a leadership, mentorship or design direction capacity; experience in SaaS, B2B, platform, workflow-heavy or other complex digital product environments is highly valuable.

  • An exceptionally strong portfolio that demonstrates systematic thinking, customer empathy, exceptional craft, measurable product impact and leadership beyond individual execution.

  • Proven experience leading data-informed product design across the full lifecycle, including research, information architecture, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, content strategy and usability testing.

  • Exceptional visual and interaction design craft, with deep care for hierarchy, layout, typography, grids, spacing, motion, usability, accessibility and product quality.

  • Experience designing for AI-driven or intelligent interfaces, including collaboration with machine learning, data, automation or platform teams.

  • Deep fluency in design systems, accessibility standards, reusable patterns and scalable product experience decisions.

  • Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows.

  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers.

  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft.

  • Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery.

  • Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps.

  • Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

  • Influence leadership decisions through customer empathy, data synthesis, product judgment, storytelling and strong design rationale.

  • Drive design quality reviews and set standards for usability, accessibility, interaction quality, visual consistency and design system alignment.

  • Raise the quality of multiple teams by mentoring designers, improving critique, strengthening shared patterns and making standards easier to adopt.

  • Define and socialize metrics for design quality and impact, such as usability signals, accessibility compliance, task success, adoption, retention or customer satisfaction.

  • Lead complex discovery and design efforts through ambiguity by synthesizing inputs, framing decisions and helping teams move with clarity.

How You Work

  • You raise the bar for craft, visual sophistication and product quality across the teams around you.

  • You move comfortably between product strategy, customer insight, systems thinking and hands-on design execution.

  • You balance speed, detail, scalability and quality without losing sight of the customer.

  • You build trust through warmth, candor, accountability and genuine respect for your teammates as people.

  • You enjoy leading collaboration across time zones and cultural contexts, including with US- and India-based teammates.

  • You communicate in ways that help distributed teams work with clarity, care, trust and momentum.

  • You advocate for accessibility, inclusion and ethical design.

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
jobs.description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

FreedomPayâs robust solutions across payments, security, identity and data analytics are available in-store, online and on-mobile and are supported by rapid API adoption. The award winning FreedomPay Commerce Platform operates on a single, unified technology stack across multiple continents allowing enterprises to deliver a consistent, repeatable experience on a global scale.  FreedomPay is a fast paced, high growth company with a great culture with competitive benefits and compensation with a business casual atmosphere.


The Strategic Account Executive, Lodging is a relationship-driven, consultative role responsible for owning a portfolio of named enterprise lodging customers and driving long-term growth, expansion, and product adoption.

This role sits above day-to-day execution and partners closely with Customer Success Managers to ensure FreedomPay delivers against customer goals. The focus is on strategic engagement within the Lodging vertical, supporting brands such as Marriott, Hyatt IHG, and similar multi-location operators.

This is not operational account management or partner management. It is a senior, customer-facing role focused on executive alignment, industry expertise, and expanding FreedomPayâs footprint within large lodging organizations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building structured account plans, QBR frameworks, or adoption strategies
  • MBA or relevant advanced degree


\n

We have offices in Philadelphia, Las Vegas, and London, and employ individuals across 20 different states and 8 different countries. All roles are hybrid, meaning that employees may work remotely but should expect periodic travel to an office. Frequency will vary pending your role and responsibilities.


As the fastest growing commerce company in the industry, we offer the opportunity for tremendous upward mobility within the company as well as development and professional growth opportunities. FreedomPay's fulltime roles provide exceptional benefits including medical, prescription, dental and vision coverage, Life Insurance, Retirement Plans with company match, commission sharing plan, flexible hybrid working environment, and great parental and other leave programs. Job Summary

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, network protocols, and API design (gRPC/Protobuf and/or RESTful APIs), with the ability to reason about tradeoffs across an entire system.

Weâd Love to See:

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) beyond a single provider.

  • Experience establishing or influencing engineering-wide standards for Terraform automation and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Deep expertise with secure protocols, mTLS and PKI, secrets management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault), and credential brokering.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer Case Execution
jobs.description:
About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

  • Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.

  • Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates.

  • Contribute to front-end and admin workflows where needed: The role is primarily backend-focused, but you'll contribute to internal-facing UI and ops tooling where the product requires it.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus

  • Strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building data-heavy, workflow-oriented systems

  • Experience working on complex, data-driven decision logic or orchestration problems: you're comfortable with systems where correctness and sequencing both matter

  • Comfortable operating in a collaborative, fast-moving startup environment where ownership and requirements evolve

  • Python experience; able to work effectively in a Python-based backend environment

  • Self-directed and proactive: you identify problems and drive them to resolution without heavy oversight

  • Strong communicator who collaborates well across engineering, product, and adjacent teams

Extra Credit If You Have

  • Experience with healthcare-specific data or HealthTech systems

  • Exposure to data-heavy architectures or problems adjacent to data engineering without being a pure data engineer

  • Familiarity with tools like Snowflake, dbt, or Databricks

  • Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions

Why Youâll Love Working Here

Weâre a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubsâLos Angeles and New Yorkâwe remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.

If youâre excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, weâd love to hear from you.

Benefits Include:

  • Competitive compensation, including equity

  • Full health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Retirement savings plan through 401(k)

  • Flexible time off

  • Opportunities for company-wide connection and events

Ready to Make an Impact?
Weâre building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.

Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and letâs transform healthcare reimbursement together.

Employment Information

Work Authorization

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Pivotal Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Reasonable Accommodations

Pivotal Health provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you need assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know.

At-Will Employment

ABOUT THE ROLE: 

Replit is redefining how software gets built — from solo developers to engineering teams at scale. As Director of Sales, you'll lead our enterprise sales motion and own the revenue engine that turns Replit's explosive product-led growth into durable, high-value contracts. You'll inherit a talented GTM team and take them to the next level.

jobs.title: Technical Recruiter
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Our Talent team is looking for an experienced and discerning technical recruiter to help build Linear’s next generation of engineering talent. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who sees recruiting as a craft.

Your primary focus will be growing our engineering team in North America. You’ll work closely with engineering leadership and our existing recruiters across product, infrastructure, AI, mobile, and emerging technical roles. You’ll own the full search, from mapping talent markets and activating networks through assessment, work trial support, and close.

Linear engineers tend to combine technical depth with product judgment, craftsmanship, and significant ownership. Finding them requires more than matching resumes to requirements. We’re looking for someone who can recognize these qualities, reach candidates with precision, and continually sharpen their judgment through close partnership with our team. All recruiters at Linear are generalists and may support other functions as company priorities evolve, but engineering will be the primary focus of this role.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North American (Eastern time zone), with a strong preference for the New York City area. Being in New York enables closer partnership with our growing local team, candidate events, and optional in-person support during work trials. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Partner directly with engineering leaders to understand their teams, develop hiring strategies, and own searches across product, infrastructure, AI, mobile, and other technical areas

 - Build consistent, high-quality pipeline through talent mapping, direct sourcing, referrals, and long-term relationship development

 - Identify engineers with strong technical foundations, product judgment, craftsmanship, and evidence of operating with significant ownership

 - Conduct in-depth recruiter assessments covering technical fluency, ownership, product sensibility, motivations, and alignment with Linear’s working environment

 - Maintain momentum through transparent communication, fast feedback loops, and clear ownership at every stage

 - Use funnel data, candidate feedback, and hiring outcomes to improve sourcing strategies and pre–work trial calibration

 - Maintain accurate, useful data in Ashby and ensure hiring partners have clear visibility into pipeline health, risks, and next steps

 - Contribute to how our small Talent team works, while remaining adaptable enough to support other functions as company needs evolve

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years of full-cycle technical recruiting experience, including hiring senior engineers at high-growth startups or product-led technology companies

 - Exceptional sourcing ability, with evidence of turning research, networks, referrals, and thoughtful outreach into qualified candidate relationships

 - Strong judgment about technical talent, product orientation, ownership, and the environments in which candidates are likely to perform best

 - The ability to build credibility with highly sought-after engineers and represent Linear’s opportunity with clarity and candor

 - A record of developing trusted, direct relationships with demanding hiring managers and technical leaders

 - Strong interviewing skills and the ability to distinguish polished interview performance from meaningful evidence of impact

 - Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication

 - High operating discipline, including thoughtful prioritization, reliable follow-through, accurate data, and fast feedback loops

 - Comfort working without heavy process on a small, distributed, high-performing team

 - Familiarity with Linear or other products and companies defined by exceptional software craftsmanship

 - A commitment to candidate experience, including the ability to deliver direct feedback and navigate complex or competitive closing conversations

 - Adaptable generalist who can quickly learn and support hiring across other functions (e.g., go-to-market) as company needs evolve

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work:

 - Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear https://linear.app/now/how-we-hire-at-linear

Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. Suspicious messages can be reported to security@linear.app.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, New Grad (Dec 2026)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.



To be eligible for this role, you need to graduate in December 2026 and be able to start full time by January/February 2027.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - You'll work with others to plan, shape, and build new product features from start to finish: through conception, research, implementation, and maintenance. For example, you might work on driving adoption, by instrumenting key onboarding moments and iterating on activation flows.

 - You'll help improve performance and reliability, or polish existing features. For example, you might update our spell checker to sync dictionaries across browsers or improve search to index file attachments.

 - You'll build internal tools to support simplicity and productivity for the whole team. This might include writing a script to import user feedback into Notion.




QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Pursuing a bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or another related field.

 - To be eligible for this role, you need to graduate by Dec 2026 and be able to start FTE by January/February 2027.

 - Previous internship experience.

 - Working towards a proficiency of one or more programming languages such as TypeScript, Node.js, or Python.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Impact-driven approach to technology: You see technologies as tools to achieve user impact rather than ends in themselves. You care more about building successful systems that solve real problems than about using specific tech stacks or following trends.
   
   - You stay current with the latest tools like Codex, Claude Code, and other AI-assisted development environments. You're pragmatic about choosing the right tool for the job, focusing on what delivers the most value to users.

 - Thoughtful problem-solving: For you, problem-solving starts with a clear and accurate understanding of the context. You can decompose tricky problems and work towards a clean solution, by yourself or with teammates. You're comfortable asking for help when you get stuck. You think about the implications of what you're building and how it will impact real people's lives.

 - Team player: For you, work isn't a solo endeavor. You enjoy collaborating cross-functionally to accomplish shared goals, and you care about learning, growing, and helping others to do the same.

 - Passion for web applications: You can work with others to build and maintain quality user interfaces for a big audience, using Web technologies like HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and a modern UI framework like React.

 - Familiarity with backend systems: You understand how parts of a system fit together—from the user interface to the data model. Familiarity with database systems like Postgres, MySQL or MongoDB is a plus.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have experience with any part of our technology stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, Postgres, and Elasticsearch.

 - You’re a builder who finds joy in building software solutions for yourself or others.

 - You care about the interaction between technology and society, the ways in which they inform each other, and our responsibility as technologists to be conscious of that relationship.

 - You've heard of computing pioneers like Ada Lovelace, Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, and others—and understand why we're big fans of their work.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated salary range for this role is $135,000 - $155,000



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.
